title: Software Engineer, Risk Management
description:
**About Us** 




 Hyperproof is on a mission to transform the Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) world with a powerful new software platform. With Hyperproof, companies can save time and money while also operating their programs at a much higher level of effectiveness and accountability. We envision a world where organizations we depend on are truly trustworthy — and Hyperproof is the platform that will get them there.
 



 We have a great team and culture — picture yourself in a highly collaborative startup environment where you can make a real impact on something truly important. It's an exciting time to be at Hyperproof; we raised our Series B round in 2023, validating our teamwork and company vision, and we continue to grow rapidly.
 



 As we continue to grow, we are seeking a talented Software Engineer to join our Risk Management team and help build first\-party risk management features that help our customers identify, assess, and mitigate organizational risk.
 



**Who You Are** 




 You are a full\-stack engineer with 3–5 years of experience who cares about building software that is correct, reliable, and genuinely useful. You thrive working across the stack — comfortable designing APIs in the morning and refining React components in the afternoon. You take pride in writing code that is well\-tested and maintainable, and you understand that in a compliance domain, data integrity is not optional.
 



 You are excited by the challenge of translating complex domain logic — risk scoring, control testing, framework alignment — into clean, intuitive product experiences. You are comfortable asking questions, engaging in design discussions, and owning features end\-to\-end. You work well in a collaborative, async\-first environment.
 



**What You Will Do** 




 As a Software Engineer on the Risk Management team, your responsibilities will include:
 


* Design, build, and ship first\-party risk management features including risk register, inherent and residual risk scoring, and risk lifecycle workflows.
* Develop and extend control testing and monitoring capabilities — automated evidence checks, test cadence scheduling, and pass/fail logic tied to compliance outcomes.
* Build integrations with compliance frameworks including SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST CSF, and others — enabling customers to map their controls and risks to the standards that matter to them.
* Collaborate with product managers and designers to translate compliance domain requirements into reliable, intuitive product experiences.
* Write backend services and APIs in C\# (.NET), Node.js, and/or Python that are performant, well\-documented, and testable.
* Build and maintain React/TypeScript front\-end components that surface complex risk data in clean, actionable dashboards.
* Participate in design reviews and code reviews, contributing to engineering quality across the team.
* Work closely with QA to ensure correctness — you understand that in a compliance product, data integrity issues have real consequences for our customers.



**What You Will Bring** 




**Required:** 



* 3–5 years of software engineering experience in a product\-focused company.
* Strong proficiency in React and TypeScript for front\-end development.
* Experience with at least one of Java Springboot, Node.js, or Python for back\-end API development.
* Comfort working across the full stack — you can own a feature from data model to UI.
* Familiarity with relational databases (PostgreSQL preferred) and writing efficient, well\-structured queries.
* Solid understanding of REST API design principles and asynchronous patterns.
* A track record of writing well\-tested code; you care about test coverage and the long\-term cost of technical debt.
* Excellent communication skills; you can engage effectively in async and cross\-functional team environments.
* A positive attitude and willingness to learn, adapt, and grow in a dynamic environment.



**Preferred:** 



* Exposure to GRC, compliance, audit, or risk management domains — even as an end user.
* Familiarity with compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST CSF, or FedRAMP.
* Experience building workflow\-heavy or state\-machine\-driven features.
* Familiarity with risk registers, control frameworks, or evidence management concepts.
* Prior experience in a B2B SaaS environment.



**Location** 




 We are a fully remote company! This role is open to candidates based in India. Rather than restrict ourselves to only finding talent in one city, we'd rather find the absolute best people regardless of where they live.
 



**Where You'll Go** 



* Hyperproof also loves to see an internal transfer. If a linear career path is not what you're looking for, you can work with your manager and our people team to explore lateral moves to other parts of the organization as you continue to grow with us.



**Compensation** 



* ₹2,137,000 \- ₹3,000,000



**WHERE YOU’LL GO** 



* Hyperproof also loves to see an internal transfer. If a linear career path is not what you’re looking for, you can work with your manager and our people team to explore lateral moves to other parts of the organization as you continue to grow with us.



**WHAT WE OFFER TO OUR EMPLOYEES** 




**Please note: Benefits listed below are for employees in the United States; contractor roles or international positions may differ** 



* Annual compensation reviews \+ equity
* Unlimited PTO: strongly encouraged to unplug and recharge
* Health: coverage for medical, dental, and vision \- employee and dependents
* 401K, which vests immediately, complete with a 4% company match
* 12 weeks of Parental leave and 1 year free diapers and wipes with Honest
* Annual company in\-person events and quarterly in\-person connects
* $500 home office stipend \- at the time of hire. Any additional home office needs are requested as needed.
* $100 quarterly paid wellness stipend
* Pet insurance discount
* Slack channel notifications turn off after 5 pm based on your time zone
* Two Hypercharge weeks of rest where we close company\-wide (July \& Dec)



 It’s an exciting time to be at Hyperproof — we recently raised $40 million in our Series B financing, further cementing Hyperproof as the emerging leader in the risk and compliance management space.
 



 At Hyperproof’s core are our passionate team members who focus on user experience, beautiful design, and evangelize a positive social impact of our cloud based platform. We help organizations streamline their risk and compliance workflows so our customers can spend more time strategically managing programs and less time wrangling spreadsheets. 
 



 We are disrupting the governance, risk, and compliance software space with our innovative platform by helping traditionally unsung heroes (compliance professionals)
 **do the right things so the wrong things don’t happen.** 




 Learn more about the @hyperproof culture and how it all started.
 



**A NOTE ABOUT OUR INTERVIEW PROCESS** 




 We’re committed to creating a fair, respectful, and secure hiring experience for everyone. As part of that commitment, we use standard verification steps throughout our interview process.
 




 Here’s what that means for you:
 



* We may conduct routine verification checks during the hiring process.
* You might be asked additional questions to better understand your experience and background.
* For video interviews, we ask that candidates be on camera without filters or visual modifications.



 These steps are applied consistently for all candidates and are designed to ensure an equitable experience for everyone.
 



**EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER** 





 Hyperproof is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace  —
 

 it’s one of our core values!
 

 Hyperproof is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status. 
 





 Our company is dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. If you're excited about this role, but your experience doesn't perfectly fit every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this role or others.
 




 To ensure a smooth interview process, all candidates will be required to provide a valid phone number that is
 *not* 
 a VOIP (Voice Over Internet Protocol) number. This helps us maintain clear and reliable communication throughout your interview experience.

title: Senior Software Engineer - C# & Kafka
description:
**What type of work will I be doing? What assignments or requirements\* will I be performing on a regular basis? What are my deliverables?** 




  




* You will work on a distributed application built on the event driven architecture.
* You will work with C\# on the server side.
* You will work with SQL/PostgreSQL/Open Search for the database.
* You will work with Kafka/Redis/RabbitMQ for inter and intra service communications.



  





**What will you bring to Omnissa?** 




  




* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science or related field
* **Strong experience building production backend services in C\# / .NET. with 9 to 14 yrs experience**
* **Hands\-on experience with Kafka or a comparable message/streaming platform.**
* Solid working knowledge of PostgreSQL (or similar relational databases) and SQL.
* Familiarity with OpenSearch, Elasticsearch, or another search/indexing engine.
* Experience with observability and telemetry: metrics, logging, and distributed tracing, ideally with Prometheus and related tooling.

**Principal UI Engineer \- Frontend/Fullstack (React, TypeScript)** 

  
 



**Get to know Okta** 




 Okta is The World’s Identity Company. We free everyone to safely use any technology, anywhere, on any device or app. Our flexible and neutral products, Okta Platform and Auth0 Platform, provide secure access, authentication, and automation, placing identity at the core of business security and growth.
 



 At Okta, we celebrate a variety of perspectives and experiences. We are not looking for someone who checks every single box \- we’re looking for lifelong learners and people who can make us better with their unique experiences. 
 



 Join our team! We’re building a world where Identity belongs to you.
 



**Access Essentials \- Core Product** 




 The Access Essentials organization at Okta builds the platform features for authentication and authorization across Okta\-protected resources. Our mission is to enable customers to access these resources seamlessly \& securely. We develop Okta cloud services and client software that allow users to seamlessly login to devices and use Okta authenticators to access applications securely. The Access Management team is part of Okta R\&D Engineering. Learn more about Okta’s Engineering on our blog.
 



**The First** 
**Party Apps Platform team** 




 First Party Apps Platform team is part of the larger Access Essential \- Core Product organization. We develop Okta’s secure web experiences for end\-user authentication and access. Our products and features are high\-impact and high\-visibility. Our team develops the Okta Sign\-in Widget, End User SSO Dashboard, and the Okta Browser Plugin.
 



**The Engineer Opportunity** 




 We seek an experienced web front\-end engineer to join our First Party Apps Platform team. The ideal candidate has extensive experience in web development, building well\-tested and maintainable software. The opportunity is an excellent chance to build software with high impact and usage. If you’re excited to work on something that millions of users will use on a daily basis, this is the opportunity for you.
 



**Job Duties and Responsibilities** 
**:** 



* Lead the design and development of complex, high\-performance features using React and TypeScript.
* Collaborate closely with product managers, UI/UX designers, and backend engineers to translate requirements into robust and effective frontend solutions.
* Write clean, modular, well\-tested, and maintainable code, adhering to best practices and coding standards.
* Optimize applications for speed, scalability, and responsiveness across various devices and browsers.
* Contribute to the evolution of our frontend architecture, ensuring its long\-term scalability and maintainability.
* Participate in code reviews, providing constructive feedback and ensuring code quality across the team.
* Proactively identify and address technical debt, performance bottlenecks, and areas for improvement.
* Stay up\-to\-date with the latest trends and technologies in frontend development, evaluating and recommending new tools and approaches.
* Champion a culture of continuous improvement, innovation, and technical excellence within the team.



**Minimum Requirements** 
**:** 



* 13\+ years of professional experience in frontend development, with a strong focus on building complex web applications.
* Deep expertise in React, including a strong understanding of its core principles, hooks, component lifecycle, and state management.
* Proficiency in TypeScript, with a proven ability to leverage its features for robust and maintainable codebases.
* Solid understanding of modern JavaScript (ES6\+), HTML5, and CSS3\.
* Experience with front\-end tooling such as Webpack, Babel, Vite, and package managers (Yarn).
* Demonstrated experience consuming and integrating with RESTful APIs.
* Familiarity with testing frameworks (e.g., Jest, React Testing Library, Playwright) and a commitment to writing comprehensive tests.
* Strong understanding of version control systems, particularly Git.
* Experience with responsive design principles and building accessible web interfaces.
* Excellent problem\-solving skills, with the ability to debug complex issues and find practical solutions.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively within a cross\-functional team.



**Nice to have** 
**:** 



* Familiarity with design systems and component libraries.
* An understanding of Identity and Access Management protocols and architecture, e.g., FIDO, U2F, WebAuth, SSO, SAML, OAuth, Federation.
* Contributions to open\-source projects.



**Education and Training:** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience
* years of experience working on large\-scale enterprise grade software

* Driving Social Impact
* Developing Talent and Fostering Connection \+ Community



 We are intentional about connection. Our global community, spanning over 20 offices worldwide, is united by a drive to innovate. Your journey begins with an immersive, in\-person onboarding experience designed to accelerate your impact and connect you to our mission and team from day one.

title: Software Engineer 1
description:
Condé Nast is one of the world's most renowned media publishing companies, creating and distributing every type of media today, spanning print and digital publishing in all formats. With a portfolio of some of today's most influential brands, the company continues to grow its audience through a global operational and content infrastructure across its 12 owned and operated markets. Headquartered in New York City, the company's owned and operated markets include China, France, Germany, India, Italy, Japan, Mexico \& Latin America, Spain, Taiwan, UAE/Dubai, the U.K., and the U.S., with additional local license partners in over twenty additional markets across the globe. Lead brands include Vogue, The New Yorker, GQ, Architectural Digest, Condé Nast Traveler, Vanity Fair, Wired, Allure, Ars Technica, Bon Appétit, House \& Garden, Pitchfork, Tatler, and Vogue Business.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Location:
   

  

 Bengaluru, KA
   

  

**About Our Engineering Team**
 Our engineering team builds and evolves Verso, the shared front\-end platform powering more than 70 Condé Nast brand sites worldwide. We specialize in modern React architectures, performance\-optimized experiences, multi\-brand configuration systems, and flexible storytelling tools that enable teams to move fast while maintaining exceptional quality.
   

  

 We value craft. We value clarity. We value performance. We value governance. We believe that exceptional digital experiences require engineering, product and design working in lockstep.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Our brands are our USP. The expression of our iconic brands – from Vogue to the New Yorker – within their digital experiences is of utmost importance in our mission to create the best places to consume and interact with our brands.
   

  

 We are hiring a Front End Software Engineer / SE1: Full stack to elevate the visual and interactive qualities of our consumer facing experiences across our portfolio of brands.
   

  

 This role focuses on craft at scale. Building and implementing user interfaces that feel premium, deliberate and performant. You will work at the intersection of brand expression, system architecture, and user experience, bringing finesse to interfaces that millions of readers interact with every day.
   

  

 You’ll collaborate closely with our Product Design Lead, editorial partners, and platform engineers to bridge design intent with production\-quality code.
   

  

****Key Responsibilities \& Areas of Impact::****
* Elevate Front End architecture
+ Build polished, high quality UI elements as React components with a strong focus on layout, typography and interactive fidelity.
+ Communicate implementation decisions clearly during code reviews and team discussions, and explain tradeoffs when appropriate.
+ Utilize modern React and Typescript features. Familiarity with React 18\+, TypeScript, hooks, suspense, SSR concepts, and emerging RSC patterns are expected.
+ You write reusable, semantic code. You need to be able to defend your rationale during peer reviews. Your code should be written with long\-term scalability in mind.
+ Work with GraphQL schemas, fragments, and resolvers to deliver efficient, minimal data payloads.
+ Work with GQL patterns that support component\-driven design and editorial storytelling flows.
+ Design with Core Web Vitals in mind, continuously improving LCP, CLS, INP, and client\-side performance.
+ Ensure accessibility, semantic HTML, responsive behaviors, and robust interaction patterns across devices and markets.
+ Use AI\-assisted engineering tools responsibly to accelerate discovery, prototyping, testing, documentation, and implementation, while maintaining ownership of code quality, security, accessibility, and performance.
+ Critically evaluate AI\-generated code and recommendations, validating correctness through tests, peer review, observability, and sound engineering judgment.
+ Identify pragmatic opportunities to use AI to improve publishing workflows, developer experience, content operations, or front\-end platform efficiency, in partnership with Product, Design, Editorial, and Data teams.
+ Contribute to responsible AI practices, including appropriate handling of confidential data, copyright\-sensitive content, bias, attribution, human review, and brand/editorial integrity.


* Contribute to our Multi\-Tenant Application
+ Contribute to our re\-use in our design system. Extend and refine shared component libraries to support brand\-distinctive layouts without sacrificing consistency.
+ Contribute to configuration\-driven approaches that allow brands to express themselves while remaining maintainable at scale.
+ Your code should be written in a way that helps enable rapid enablement. You approach problems with a pragmatic perspective and find solutions during the discovery phase that allows for rapid enablement.
+ Participate in design reviews, architectural discussions, and platform strategy.
+ Follow established engineering standards for code quality, accessibility, and performance..


**What We’re Looking For (Experience \& Skills)**
* 2\+ years of experience developing high\-quality front\-end experiences using React and TypeScript.
* Strong understanding with GraphQL, including fragments, schemas, and component\-oriented queries.
* Solid understanding of modern React (hooks, suspense, SSR/Hydration, RSC concepts).
* Strong CSS fundamentals (layout systems, responsive design, animation, typography).
* Strong understanding of accessibility, usability, and inclusive design principles.
* Experience optimizing Core Web Vitals and reducing real\-world runtime costs.
* Curious mindset with a desire to learn, iterate, and push the platform forward.
* Experience using AI\-assisted development tools such as coding assistants, chat\-based technical copilots, or AI\-supported documentation/search workflows.
* Ability to prompt, critique, test, and refine AI\-generated outputs rather than accepting them unreviewed.
* Awareness of responsible AI considerations, including privacy, security, intellectual property, accessibility, bias, and editorial trust.
* Curiosity about AI\-enabled product experiences and how they can support publishing, storytelling, personalization, discovery, or internal tooling.


****Nice to have****
* Experience integrating AI\-powered features into web applications, such as streaming responses, prompt\-driven interfaces, semantic search, recommendations, summarization, or editorial assistance tools.
* Familiarity with LLM APIs, embeddings, RAG patterns, evaluation workflows, or AI observability.
* Experience designing user interfaces for AI\-assisted workflows with clear feedback, confidence cues, human\-in\-the\-loop review, and graceful failure states.


**What happens next?**
 If you are interested in this opportunity, please apply below, and we will review your application as soon as possible. You can update your resume or upload a cover letter at any time by accessing your candidate profile.
   

  

***Condé Nast is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, age, familial status and other legally protected characteristics.***

title: Senior Web Developer
description:
Equiti is a pioneering fintech firm and world\-class provider of multi\-asset fintech products \- from liquidity solutions to in\-house tech hubs to online trading platforms. With over 400 global specialists in 9 languages, Equiti provides clients with access to individual, professional, and institutional broke’rage services in Europe, the Middle East, and Africa.
 



 At Equiti, we believe that financial opportunities can unlock potential for everyone, everywhere. We’re on a mission to deliver accessible online trading products around the world through education and accessibility.
 



  





 Think finance is stuffy? Think again.
 



  





 We see Equiti as a new breed of broker, and we are on the lookout for talented individuals who can perform and excel in a dynamic and innovative working environment. Our
 **Client Ecosystem department** 
 would like to welcome a detail\-oriented.
 



  





**Senior Web Developer** 
 in our office in
 **Bangalore** 




  





**Responsibilities** 



* Lead end‑to‑end delivery of complex features across our web platform and microfrontends.
* Define web architecture and boundaries; champion shared libraries, design tokens, and CI/CD standards.
* Optimize SSR, hydration/resumability, and Core Web Vitals for TypeScript/Qwik‑ or React‑like stacks; set performance budgets.
* Ensure reliability, security, and compliance in key user flows (auth, payments, KYC) with robust observability and SLOs.
* Establish testing strategy (unit, E2E, contract, visual); raise coverage and prevent regressions.
* Own accessibility (WCAG 2\.1 AA), internationalization, and localization workflows.
* Partner with Product/Design/Backend to shape roadmaps and deliver incrementally.
* Mentor engineers, lead code reviews, write docs/ADRs, run technical workshops.
* Improve pipelines (Azure Pipelines), releases, incident response, and root‑cause analysis.



  





**Skills \& Competencies** 



* Expert TypeScript, semantic HTML/CSS/Tailwind; deep knowledge of SSR frameworks.
* Strong system design for web: caching/CDN, microfrontend composition, API contracts, security.
* Proven performance optimization and scalability for real‑time UIs.
* Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management.



  





**Experience Requirements** 



* 6\+ years building large‑scale web apps; 2\+ years leading projects/teams.
* Production experience with SSR frameworks, microfrontends, and Azure CI/CD.
* Track record improving Core Web Vitals, accessibility, and test reliability at scale.



  





**Nice to have** 



* Fintech/trading domain, streaming charts, payments orchestration, security reviews.
* Module Federation, design systems, and DX tooling.



  





**Perks** 




 Each of our offices has its special perks; be it ‘no ties’, free lunches, charity events, or a hybrid work policy – but whenever you walk into an Equiti office, you’re sure to see a friendly face. We encourage international collaborations and always keep our eyes open to how we can do more.
 



 The benefits you can expect at your Equiti workplace include:
 



  




* Competitive salary package
* Performance\-based bonus
* Medical insurance coverage for employees and family members
* Smart working options
* Employee wellness initiatives
* Personalized career development
* Company lunch in the office
* Regular company events



  





 With energy, drive, and imagination, there’s no limit to where your career can go at Equiti. With a diverse workforce and geographical spread of offices, we strongly support career development initiatives as well as provide a range of opportunities for professional and life experiences.
 



  





 Equiti is an equal opportunity employer.
 



  





 “Equiti” refers to a group of companies consisting of seven regulated financial services companies licensed to operate in the respective jurisdictions of their incorporation, in addition to our tech and marketing hubs. Equiti has presence in Africa, Europe, and the Middle East.

title: Principal Software Engineer - FE
description:
**About The Job**
 If you want to build, develop, and see your impact, join Skillz and level up your Career!
   

  

 Skillz, the first publicly\-traded mobile eSports platform that hosts billions of casual mobile gaming tournaments for millions of players worldwide, is revolutionizing the gaming industry. By fostering social competition within games, the Skillz platform helps developers build multi\-million dollar franchises by enabling real\-money activity in their games and providing operational support while connecting players through fair, enjoyable, and meaningful competition.
   

  

 At Skillz, we understand the thrill of achievement and the satisfaction of overcoming challenges. Want to join a team made up of alums from Apple, Amazon, Google, Microsoft, Tesla, Twitter (X), Roblox, Zynga, Samsung, Lyft, EA, Riot, Nexon, Gameskraft, PlayStation, Unity, Scopely, Tinder, Intel, Deloitte, EY, Twitch, DraftKings, Wynn Resorts and more? Learn more to see if Skillz is the right fit for your next career move!
   

  

**What You’ll Own**
 As the complexity of our SDK grows—across expanding product lines, multi\-platform support, and increasing real\-time demands—we need a highly experienced technical leader to architect, guide, and future\-proof our engineering efforts across domains.
   

  

 The Principal Software Engineer \- FE, is expected to do the following
   

  

* Strategic Technical Leadership: Lead the design and evolution of the frontend architecture for our Native(Android and IOS), Web and React Native\-based products, ensuring scalability, performance, security, and maintainability.
* Elevate the React Native SDK Experience: Own the development and continuous improvement of our Native components and React Native SDK for third\-party game developers, enabling seamless integration with the Skillz platform.
* Mentorship \& Talent Development: They will mentor lead, senior and mid\-level engineers, raising the overall technical bar and creating a culture of engineering excellence in frontend.
* Deliver Exceptional User Experiences: Apply deep expertise in performance optimisation, accessibility, responsiveness, and user interaction design to elevate the overall product experience.
* Support Business Growth and Innovation: Evaluate new technologies, frameworks, and tools that advance our competitive advantage while balancing risk, cost, and engineering velocity.
* Accelerating Innovation: Their presence reduces technical risk for new initiatives and helps compress time to market by identifying reusable patterns and common frameworks.


**What You Bring**
* At least 12\+ years of professional experience in frontend engineering with modern JavaScript/TypeScript and at least one major framework (React, Vue, or Angular); depth in React strongly preferred.
* Proven experience building and shipping consumer\-facing mobile experiences — either via React Native / native (iOS/Android) or web clients embedded in mobile game flows.
* Deep expertise in client\-side performance engineering: rendering optimisation, state management at scale, bundle size discipline, and low\-latency real\-time UI (WebSockets / event\-driven updates).
* Deep expertise in client\-side performance engineering: rendering optimisation, state management at scale, bundle size discipline, and low\-latency real\-time UI (WebSockets / event\-driven updates).
* Experience in the Gaming Industry (ideally), including familiarity with game clients, engines (e.g., Unity), or SDK integration—alternatively, a genuine passion for building polished, high\-engagement interfaces for games.
* Strong experience with component architecture, design systems, cross\-platform consistency, and integrating against distributed, multi\-tiered backend services.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a technical field of study, or equivalent industry experience.
* Able to work in\-office 3 days a week in Bangalore, India.


 Why Skillz ?
   

  

* Culture of Impact: Join a united team of builders, creators, innovators, and entrepreneurs driven by the desire to win. At Skillz, we create value, obsess over our product, and make a difference in the world.
* Recognized Success: Skillz has earned recognition as one of Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, CNBC's Disruptor 50, San Francisco Business Times' Best Places to Work, Forbes' Next Billion\-Dollar Startups, and the \#1 fastest\-growing company in America on the Inc. 5000 list, and many more.
* Development Opportunities: We hold our employees to high standards while providing them with professional growth opportunities. We operate like a startup, and encourage all of our employees to collaborate and voice feedback about our product and ways we can improve as a business. We believe in never settling, and that also pertains to your growth.


 Skillz embraces diversity and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As part of our commitment to diversifying our workforce, we do not discriminate on the basis of age, race, sex, gender, gender identity, color, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, marital status, citizenship, veteran status, or disability status, and we operate in compliance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance
 *.*

****Who We Are****
 80% of the workers across the globe are Deskless. These are the people who keep our lights on and gas flowing, build roads and bridges, run our manufacturing factories, ensure that we get healthcare service, and provide us with reliable phone and internet connectivity. As entrepreneurs, have we considered solving their problems and making them more productive?
   

  

 Zinier is a company on a mission to empower frontline workers \- and the people supporting them \- to achieve greater things for themselves and the world around them. With the majority of workers worldwide being deskless, Zinier recognizes the need for Technology Equity to improve the lives and productivity of these workers who keep the world up and running.
   

  

 We are a remote\-first, global team headquartered in Silicon Valley, with a hybrid workforce across the United States, Canada, Europe, Latin America, Singapore, and Bangalore, India, with leading investors that include Accel, ICONIQ Capital, Founders Fund, Newfund Capital, NGP Capital, Tiger Global Management, and Qualcomm Ventures LLC.
   

  

****What We're Looking For****
 We are looking for a SDE to join our rapidly expanding Engineering team.
   

  

****Responsibilities****
* Application Development – Design, develop, configure, and enhance business applications using the Zinier Low/No\-Code Platform.
* Module Development – Build new modules, workflows, business rules, UI components, and application capabilities based on product requirements.
* Application Enhancement – Analyze existing modules and continuously improve functionality, usability, reliability, and performance.
* Integration Development – Build and maintain integrations with REST APIs, third\-party applications, enterprise systems, and other services.
* End\-to\-End Development – Work across frontend, backend, APIs, integrations, and platform components to deliver complete solutions.
* Testing \& Quality Assurance – Develop unit, integration, and functional tests and ensure high\-quality production releases.
* Performance \& Security – Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks and implement secure application development practices, including protection against XSS, CSRF/XSRF, and other common web vulnerabilities.
* AI\-Native Development – Build and integrate AI/LLM\-powered capabilities such as copilots, intelligent automation, recommendations, and AI\-assisted workflows.
* Production Support – Diagnose and resolve application, integration, and production issues efficiently.
* Collaboration – Work closely with Product Managers, Designers, Architects, QA, and other engineering teams to deliver robust solutions.
* Version Control \& Deployment – Follow engineering best practices using Git, CI/CD pipelines, code reviews, and automated testing.
* Continuous Improvement – Identify opportunities to improve application architecture, development processes, platform capabilities, and engineering productivity.


****Required Skills****
* 6–10 years of software development experience building scalable web applications.
* Strong programming fundamentals in JavaScript/TypeScript.
* Experience with modern frontend frameworks such as React.js or Angular.
* Good understanding of asynchronous programming, AJAX/fetch, JSON, REST APIs, and web application architecture.
* Experience with API integrations, authentication, authorization, and API security.
* Experience with unit testing frameworks such as Jest, Jasmine, or Mocha.
* Strong debugging and problem\-solving skills.
* Experience with Git and CI/CD practices.
* Understanding of web performance optimization and cross\-browser compatibility.
* Ability to work effectively in a low\-code/no\-code application development environment.


**AI\-Native Development — Must Have**
* Hands\-on experience building or integrating applications powered by LLMs or AI services.
* Experience with AI/LLM platforms or APIs such as OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Vertex AI, Amazon Bedrock, or similar.
* Experience designing and iterating on prompt flows and AI workflows.
* Understanding of structured outputs, function/tool calling, RAG, or agentic workflows.
* Ability to evaluate AI output quality and design mechanisms for monitoring, feedback, and continuous improvement.
* Understanding of AI application security, data privacy, hallucination mitigation, and access control.


**Backend Development — Good to Have**
* Experience with Java/JEE, Spring Boot, and RESTful services.
* Understanding of database design, schemas, and SQL/NoSQL databases.
* Exposure to microservices architecture.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.


****What Would Make a Candidate Successful****
* Strong software engineering fundamentals rather than dependence on a particular framework.
* Ability to translate business requirements into working applications.
* Comfortable working across UI → business logic → APIs → integrations → data.
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
* Curiosity and willingness to learn new platform capabilities and AI technologies.
* Ability to balance configuration, low\-code development, and custom engineering appropriately.

title: Web Developer
description:
**About Us**
 M\&C Saatchi Performance is a global digital media agency, connecting brands to people. We deliver business growth for our clients through effective, measurable, and evolving digital media strategies.
   

  

**About The Role**
 This role is hands\-on development to support different teams across the business, Marketing, SEO/GEO, Creative and CRO, on our site and on client platforms.
   

  

**What this role will own** 
 :
   

  

* Our website
* Site revamps: build and ship the website revamp and the wider redesign, from approved wireframes and copy through to development, QA and launch.
* Templates and page builds: location pages, service and sector pages, section pages, blog and article templates, author pages, landing pages and campaign pages.
* Performance: Core Web Vitals, page speed, caching and plugin hygiene, with a full mobile responsiveness overhaul.
* Integrations: HubSpot forms and tracking, GA4 and Google Tag Manager, job listings via ATS API, and other martech connections.
* Maintenance: plugin and core updates, security, staging\-to\-production workflow, backups, uptime and bug fixes.
* CRO, analytics and measurement
* Experimentation: implement A/B tests and CRO changes using VWO, Optimizely, Adobe Target or equivalent, and support the testing roadmap.
* Front and back end: implement conversion changes across both website and app surfaces.
* Tracking implementation: build and QA GA4 and GTM events, data layers, conversion tracking and experiment tracking, working with the CRO and analytics teams.
* Debugging: diagnose tracking issues confidently using browser DevTools, GTM Preview, GA4 DebugView and similar.
* SEO and GEO implementation
* Technical foundations: XML sitemaps, robots.txt (including AI crawler rules for GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot and others), canonical tags, redirects, hreflang where relevant, and llms.txt.
* Structured data: Organization, Service, Article and FAQ JSON\-LD implemented from specifications supplied by the SEO/GEO team, validated error\-free.
* On\-page execution: metadata, heading structure, internal linking, schema and content\-structure changes that make pages readable to search engines and AI answer engines.
* Diagnostics: work with the SEO/GEO team on crawl, indexation and log analysis, and fix what the audits surface.
* Client delivery
* Implementation on client sites: deliver technical SEO/GEO scopes across client platforms, WordPress, Shopify, Webflow, and headless or other CMSs such as Contentful, to agreed acceptance criteria.
* Scoping and estimating: size the technical work in audits, pitches and retainers so we quote accurately and commit to realistic timelines.
* Documentation: clear handover notes and QA evidence the account and SEO teams can share with clients.


**What We're Looking For**
**Essential** 
 :
   

  

* 4–6 years building and maintaining sites in a commercial or agency environment.
* Hands\-on experience across more than one CMS (WordPress plus Shopify, Webflow or similar).
* Strong PHP, HTML, CSS and JavaScript; comfortable with custom themes, page builders and custom post types.
* Working knowledge of React and of database management, SQL and MongoDB.
* Demonstrable technical SEO implementation experience \- schema, canonicals, sitemaps, redirects, Core Web Vitals \- and comfort taking direction from GEO/SEO specialists.
* Practical tracking and analytics skills: GA4, Google Tag Manager, Google Search Console, and QA of events and data layers.
* Experience implementing A/B tests through VWO, Optimizely, Adobe Target or equivalent.
* Git\-based workflow, staging environments and structured QA before anything goes live.
* Comfortable working from design files in Figma.
* Able to run several projects and concurrent requests from marketing, SEO and client teams in parallel: strong attention to detail, reliable on deadlines, and honest about what fits in the schedule.
* Excellent business\-level English communication.
* Exposure to GEO, AEO or AI\-search optimisation, or genuine curiosity about it.


**Desirable**
* Headless CMS experience (Contentful or similar).
* HubSpot CMS, forms or CRM integration experience.
* Cloudflare, WP Engine or comparable managed hosting; bot and crawler analytics.
* UI/UX sensibility \- you can work from a wireframe, collaborate with designers to bring concepts to life, and flag early when something won't hold up in the browser. Figma and Adobe XD experience is a plus.
* Prototyping ability, and back\-end work for landing page designs, A\+ content and interactive media.
* Agency background and comfort working with client\-facing teams.


**How We'll Measure The Role**
* Development throughput and on\-time delivery against the website roadmap.
* Site health: Core Web Vitals, mobile usability, uptime, and zero critical technical SEO errors.
* Speed from SEO/GEO recommendations to live implementation.

title: Robotic Machine Tending & CNC Programmer
description:
**Company Profile** 
 Twara Robotics is an Indian industrial robot manufacturer and part of the ACE Micromatic Group. We design and build articulated robot arms and turnkey robotic welding systems, with both hardware and software developed in\-house in Bengaluru.Our focus is on making automation accessible to Indian manufacturers. Our welding robots are lightweight, work with the welding power sources customers already own, and can be set up by welders and shop\-floor engineers without a dedicated robot programmer. Systems are deployed across heavy engineering and auto component plants, and are backed by service support through the ACE Micromatic network of 70\+ offices nationwide.
 



  





**Role Description** 




 We are seeking a highly skilled
 **Machine Tending \& CNC Programmer** 
 to join our team in Bangalore. This is a full\-time, on\-site role focused on the programming, operation, troubleshooting, testing, and maintenance of robotic machine tending cells and CNC machining operations.
 



 The successful candidate will be responsible for building and commissioning machine tending systems, creating and optimising CNC programs for turning and machining centres, and supporting the testing and validation of automated machine tending cells. The role involves hands\-on work with industrial robots, CNC machines, grippers, sensors, safety systems, and machine interfaces.
 



 The candidate will work closely with engineering, production, and customer teams to support installations, resolve technical issues, improve machining and automation performance, and ensure maximum uptime and productivity.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* Program, operate, and optimise industrial robots for machine tending applications.
* Create, modify, and optimise CNC programs for turning and machining centres.
* Build, install, and commission robotic machine tending cells.
* Integrate robots with CNC machines, sensors, grippers, and peripheral equipment.
* Troubleshoot mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, CNC, and automation\-related issues.
* Support production, validate part quality, and improve cycle times and uptime.
* Perform preventive maintenance and ensure compliance with safety standards.
* Document programs, setups, and troubleshooting procedures, and train operators as required.



**Qualifications** 



* Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Manufacturing, Mechatronics, Electrical, Electronics, or a related field.
* Minimum 2 years of hands\-on experience with robotic machine tending and CNC programming.
* Experience with industrial robots such as Fanuc, ABB, Yaskawa, KUKA, Universal Robots, or similar.
* Strong understanding of CNC lathes, machining centres, and automated manufacturing systems.
* Ability to independently create, troubleshoot, and optimise robot and CNC programs.
* Ability to read engineering drawings, schematics, and technical documentation.
* Willingness to travel and work on customer sites when required.



**Preferred Skills** 



* CNC programming using Fanuc Controller.
* Experience with CAM software such as Mastercam, Fusion 360, NX CAM, or equivalent.
* Basic PLC troubleshooting and machine\-to\-robot interfacing knowledge.
* Experience with CNC automation, unattended machining, and cycle time optimisation.
* Familiarity with grippers, end\-of\-arm tooling, and machine tending system design.

* Research and Prototype: Dedicate time to exploring cutting\-edge security trends and technical solutions to stay ahead of evolving digital threats.

**About You**
 We believe that great software is built by great people. We are looking for a collaborative problem\-solver who thrives in a dynamic environment, possesses a deep curiosity about how the web works under the hood, and genuinely cares about making the digital world a safer place.
   

  

 We would love to connect if this sounds like you:
   

  

 Your Collaborative \& Behavioral Strengths
   

  

* A Natural Connector: You have a proven ability to form genuine, positive relationships across multiple levels of an organization.
* An Effective Influencer: Your communication and influencing skills allow you to articulate complex technical ideas clearly, whether you are chatting with an individual contributor or presenting a concept to the executive team.
* Thriving in Growth: You feel energized working in a faster\-paced, high\-growth environment where your work has a visible, daily impact.


 Your Technical Passions \& Expertise
   

  

* A JavaScript Specialist: 5 to 8 years of experience.
* You possess a deep, detailed understanding of JavaScript core features, including advanced techniques for modifying the behavior of built\-in features (like Proxy, apply, and monkey patching).
* Browser Security Minded: You have a strong grasp of essential browser security measures, keeping things like CORS, CSP, and Trusted Types top\-of\-mind as you develop.
* Web \& Networking Savvy: You are highly familiar with core networking concepts (such as HTTPS, proxies, and WebSockets) and understand the vital importance of the browser secure context.
* Performance \& Automation Driven: You care about smooth user experiences and know how to use performance measurement tools like Lighthouse. You also enjoy leveraging browser automation frameworks like Cypress, Selenium, or Playwright to streamline workflows.
* An Enterprise Solution Mindset: Your background includes successfully positioning and aligning software solutions within enterprise accounts, navigating all levels of decision\-makers.
* Quality \& Security Focused: You value robust code and are familiar with JavaScript testing frameworks (including writing clean unit tests and mocks). Your toolkit also includes an understanding of website reverse\-engineering, vulnerability testing, and security analysis tools like SAST and DAST.
* User\-Centric at Heart: Your history with and appreciation for UI/UX design is what drives you to develop great, seamless software interfaces that users actually enjoy interacting with.

 We believe that the best solutions are developed by teams who embrace each other's unique experiences, skills, and abilities. We work hard to create a dynamic workforce where we encourage everyone to bring their authentic selves to work every day. We offer a variety of social programs, flexible work hours and family\-friendly benefits to all of our employees.
   

  

* Retirement Plans
* Medical, Dental and Vision Coverage
* Paid Time Off
* Paid Parental Leave
* Support for Community Involvement


 We're serious about our commitment to a workplace where everyone can thrive and contribute to our industry\-leading products and customer support, which is why we prohibit discrimination and harassment based on race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation or any other legally protected status.
   

  

**Our Commitment To You**
 At Skyhigh Security, we are committed to creating a safe and trustworthy experience for our customers, employees, and candidates. Please be aware that fraudulent recruiting activity can occur through fake job postings or impersonated communications.

title: Software Engineer Lead Consultant
description:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.
   

  

**Job Description**
 We are seeking an experienced Lead Consultant – Guidewire Integrations to lead the design, development, and implementation of integration solutions across the Guidewire InsuranceSuite platform. The successful candidate will provide technical leadership, mentor development teams, collaborate with business stakeholders, and ensure the delivery of scalable, secure, and high\-quality integration solutions in a Guidewire Cloud environment.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Lead the design and implementation of Guidewire integration solutions across PolicyCenter.
* Drive technical architecture and integration strategy for enterprise systems.
* Design and develop integrations using Guidewire APIs, messaging, event\-driven architectures, and third\-party services.
* Collaborate with business analysts, solution architects, and product owners to define integration requirements and technical solutions.
* Provide technical leadership, code reviews, and mentoring to development team members.
* Ensure adherence to Guidewire best practices, coding standards, and cloud implementation guidelines.
* Troubleshoot complex production issues and lead root cause analysis activities.
* Support CI/CD pipelines, release management, and deployment activities.
* Participate in architecture reviews and contribute to long\-term platform strategy.
* Coordinate with cross\-functional teams and external vendors to deliver integration initiatives.


**Required Qualifications**
* 8\+ years of software development experience with at least 5\+ years working on Guidewire implementations.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Guidewire InsuranceSuite integrations.
* Extensive experience with: Guidewire CloudREST APIsSOAP Web ServicesEvent MessagingIntegration GatewayJSON/XMLOAuth/OpenID Connect
* Strong proficiency in Java, Gosu, and integration design patterns.
* Experience integrating Guidewire with enterprise applications, payment providers, document management systems, identity providers, and external partner systems.
* Experience with cloud\-native development and DevOps practices.
* Strong understanding of security, authentication, and authorization frameworks.
* Experience leading development teams and technical delivery.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.


 Required Certification
   

  

* Guidewire Certified Associate – InsuranceSuite Developer (or current Guidewire Associate Certification relevant to the candidate's track). This certification validates platform\-level Guidewire knowledge and is required for Guidewire Cloud projects.


**Preferred / Good\-to\-Have Certifications**
* Guidewire Certified Specialist – Integration.
* Guidewire Certified Professional – InsuranceSuite Cloud Integration Developer.
* Guidewire Certified Ace – InsuranceSuite Cloud Integration Developer.
* Guidewire Cloud certifications related to current Guidewire Cloud releases.
* AWS, Azure, or GCP Cloud Certifications.
* MuleSoft, Kafka, or API Management certifications.


**Preferred Experience**
* P\&C Insurance industry experience.
* Experience with Guidewire PolicyCenter, BillingCenter, and ClaimCenter integrations.
* Experience with event streaming platforms such as Kafka.
* Experience with CI/CD tools and automated deployment pipelines.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum delivery environments.
* Familiarity with monitoring, observability, and production support processes.


 Leadership Competencies
   

  

* Technical leadership and mentoring.
* Solution architecture and design.
* Stakeholder management.
* Problem\-solving and analytical thinking.
* Communication and presentation skills.
* Delivery ownership and accountability.
* Ability to lead multiple initiatives concurrently.

 Software Development

One where you can shape the future of protection while supporting causes that mean the most to you. Joining our team means being part of something bigger – a winning team making a meaningful impact.**
 The Allstate Corporation is one of the largest publicly held insurance providers in the United States. title: Software Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
**Change the world. Love your job.**
 Software at TI usually refers to embedded software (such as device firmware, device peripheral drivers, software frameworks, algorithms, etc.) and the related software development tools (compilers, simulators, demo software, IDEs, etc.)
   

  

 Software engineers are critical to our “whole\-product” offerings. We rely on them to ensure our products are easy to use and customers can get our products up and running quickly. To do that, they partner closely with our product development and demand creation teams on pre\-silicon software design and requirements as well as software validation and test activities. They also have an eye for backwards and cross\-compatibility and reuse to ensure we are as efficient as possible.
   

  

 In addition, software engineers might work directly with customers on any issues that arise and deliver on\-going support along with regular software releases, which includes quality assurance and release management activities.
   

  

 As a Software Engineer, some of your responsibilities may include:
   

  

* Requirements definition, design, development, test, integration, and support of embedded software (e.g. operating system software, device drivers, software frameworks, algorithmic libraries etc.) and software development tools (compilers, simulators, IDEs, etc.)
* Following established software development methodology and practices defined for the business
* Developing and applying machine learning algorithms to edge applications, which may include using AI coding assistant to develop embedded software
* Supporting pre\-silicon design and requirements as well as software validation activities
* Impacting hardware architecture requirements from a software usage, compatibility, performance, and reuse potential perspectives
* Using the most up to date coding languages, conducting server analysis and reporting infrastructure
* Creating and maintaining customer collateral for software products and deliverables
* Working closely with TI teams (silicon, hardware, software teams) and customers as part of the normal software life\-cycle
* Quality assurance and configuration/release management


 ASM (Application Specific MCU) SW group has a strong and robust software development team focused on solving some of the most challenging technical problems in automotive and industrial. We believe that hardware and software advancements go hand in hand, and to give our customers seamless, integrated solutions, we need to drive cutting\-edge innovations in both. If software is your passion, TI is the right place for you. Our SW strategy rests open source and community focused SW development which allows you to connects you with 1000s of like\-minded engineers whose passion is to innovate and share!
   

  

 We are seeking an Embedded Security Software Architect to define the software security architecture for our next\-generation microcontrollers (MCUs) targeting automotive and industrial markets. In this role, you will bridge the gap between hardware and software, converting silicon capabilities into robust, scalable security software solutions. You will collaborate closely with silicon systems engineers designing custom security IP, work directly with the ROM team to secure the earliest stages of device boot, and serve as a technical mentor to junior security software engineers on the team.
   

  

**Qualifications**
**Key Responsibilities**
* Security Software Architecture: Architect, define, and document end\-to\-end security software solutions for MCU platforms, covering secure boot, secure firmware updates (FOTA), runtime security, and secure execution environments.
* Crypto \& Key Infrastructure: Define software frameworks for cryptographic key management and manufacturing\-time provisioning configurations.
* HSM Service Integration: Design the software interfaces and middleware to fully utilize the gamut of boot\-time and runtime hardware security services offered by the HSM, including secure storage isolation, hardware\-accelerated cryptographic primitives, and secure debug.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Partner with hardware systems engineers to co\-define and integrate security hardware IPs (HSM, SHE, Crypto Accelerators).
* Silicon Boot Optimization: Work closely with the ROM design and development teams to ensure a flawless, immutable hardware Root of Trust (RoT) and secure first\-stage bootloaders.
* Technical Leadership \& Mentorship: Act as a key technical guide for the security software engineering team, providing architectural oversight, code reviews, and mentoring junior engineers, without direct supervisory duties.
* Domain Standards \& Compliance: Drive compliance strategies for rigorous automotive and industrial standards, including ISO 26262 (Functional Safety), ISO/SAE 21434 (Automotive Cybersecurity), and IEC 62443 (Industrial Automation). \[1]


**Qualifications \& Requirements**
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent.
* Experience: 5\-10 years of experience in embedded software development (C/Assembly), with a minimum of 5 years dedicated strictly to embedded software security architecture.
* Industry Domain Knowledge: Proven experience delivering security software for automotive or industrial functional safety/security environments.
* Hardware/Software Co\-Design: Deep technical understanding of microcontroller architectures (e.g., ARM Cortex\-M/R, RISC\-V), TrustZone, MPUs, and Hardware Security Modules (HSM).
* Full\-Spectrum HSM Competency: Proven experience implementing both boot\-time (e.g., hardware\-enforced secure boot, image verification, key injection verification) and runtime (e.g., cryptographic offloading, secure communication stacks like SecOC/TLS, life\-cycle state management, runtime tampering/exception handling) services.
* Communication \& Mentorship: Exceptional leadership skills with a proven track record of mentoring junior engineers and translating complex silicon hardware concepts into actionable software requirements.
* Desired Extras: Hands\-on experience with Rust programming for embedded systems, working familiarity with operating systems/RTOS environments such as Linux, Zephyr, FreeRTOS, or ThreadX is a plus.


**About Us**
**Why TI?**
* Engineer your future. We empower our employees to truly own their career and development. Come collaborate with some of the smartest people in the world to shape the future of electronics.
* We're different by design. Diverse backgrounds and perspectives are what push innovation forward and what make TI stronger. We value each and every voice, and look forward to hearing yours. Meet the people of TI
* Benefits that benefit you. We offer competitive pay and benefits designed to help you and your family live your best life. Your well\-being is important to us. Please find our country\-specific benefits here


**About Texas Instruments**
 Texas Instruments Incorporated (Nasdaq: TXN) is a global semiconductor company that designs, manufactures and sells analog and embedded processing chips for markets such as industrial, automotive, data center, personal electronics and communications equipment. At our core, we have a passion to create a better world by making electronics more affordable through semiconductors. This passion is alive today as each generation of innovation builds upon the last to make our technology more reliable, more affordable and lower power, making it possible for semiconductors to go into electronics everywhere. Learn more at TI.com .
   

  

 Texas Instruments is an equal opportunity employer and supports a diverse, inclusive work environment.
   

  

 If you are interested in this position, please apply to this requisition.
   

  

**About The Team**
 TI does not make recruiting or hiring decisions based on citizenship, immigration status or national origin. However, if TI determines that information access or export control restrictions based upon applicable laws and regulations would prohibit you from working in this position without first obtaining an export license, TI expressly reserves the right not to seek such a license for you and either offer you a different position that does not require an export license or decline to move forward with your employment.

title: Java Software Engineer
description:
**Job Responsibilities** 



* Design, develop and maintain Java 21 / Spring Boot–based microservices and batch programs, meeting agreed quality, performance and timeliness goals.
* Translate functional and non\-functional requirements into robust RESTful APIs, service contracts and domain models aligned with microservices principles.
* Implement secure, resilient and observable services, including structured logging, metrics and exception handling, in line with security and compliance standards.
* Collaborate with architects, product owners, business analysts and QA to refine user stories, estimate effort and ensure end\-to\-end delivery quality.
* Develop and unit\-test assigned user stories using Java 21 and Spring Boot, ensuring adherence to coding standards, performance, security and compliance metrics.
* Implement REST APIs, integrations and batch jobs with adequate unit and basic integration test coverage.
* Participate in daily scrums and other Agile ceremonies, providing accurate status, risk/issue highlighting and estimates.
* Participate in team code reviews, both as reviewer and reviewee, and incorporate feedback promptly.
* Analyse, debug and resolve defects across development, SIT and UAT environments within agreed SLAs.
* Participate in and contribute to peer code reviews, enforcing coding standards, performance guidelines and clean code practices for Java and Spring Boot.
* Ensure clear, maintainable inline code documentation and technical notes to aid future maintenance and production support.
* Continuously enhance skills in Java 21 (and newer versions), Spring Boot, microservices patterns, caching and database technologies relevant to the platform.



**Key Skills** 



* Strong hands\-on coding experience in backend development.
* At least 5\+ years of experience developing APIs and microservices using Java (preferably Java 11\+; Java 21 experience strongly preferred).
* Deep experience with Spring Boot for building RESTful services, including dependency injection, validation, configuration management and actuator.
* Strong understanding of REST API design, versioning, error handling and documentation (e.g., OpenAPI/Swagger).
* Experience with caching frameworks (e.g., Redis, Caffeine) and patterns to improve performance and scalability.
* Experience with SQL databases and ORM frameworks (JPA/Hibernate), plus exposure to NoSQL/persistence patterns as applicable.
* Good understanding of microservices architecture concepts such as service discovery, configuration management, resilience and API gateways.
* Familiarity with Git, CI/CD pipelines and containerization (Docker; Kubernetes exposure is a plus).
* Awareness of security best practices for APIs (authentication, authorization, OWASP considerations) in a financial services environment is preferred.

title: Software Engineer - 2 (Voicebot)
description:
**About Us** 




 Exotel is a leading provider of AI transformation to enterprises for customer engagement and experience. With over 20 billion annual conversations across Omni channel, voice, agents, and bots, Exotel is trusted by more than 7000 clients worldwide, spanning industries such as BFSI, Logistics, Consumer Durables, E\-commerce, Healthcare, and Education.
 



 Customer expectations are evolving, and businesses face the challenge of balancing the need for increased revenue, optimized costs, and exceptional customer experience (CX). Exotel steps forward as your transformative partner, offering an AI\-powered communication solution to address all three!
 



  





**AI @ Exotel Voicebot** 




 The Voicebot team builds and operates Exotel's real\-time voice AI product — production bots handling live phone conversations for enterprise customers.
 



 We run real\-time conversational pipelines end to end: speech recognition → LLM reasoning/orchestration → speech synthesis, with tool\-calling for backend actions.
 



 We evaluate and swap models constantly across providers, on cost, latency, and conversation quality — not vibes.
 



 We believe in measuring what matters: a good demo isn't the same as a good eval.
 



  





**The Role** 




 You'll be part of the team building and continuously improving Exotel's voicebot — from the model layer (fine\-tuning, evals) to the live conversation experience (speech quality, latency, turn\-taking). This is an engineering role first: you'll build, evaluate, and ship changes that directly improve call quality and business metrics in live customer deployments.
 



  





**What We Expect at This Level** 




**Independent execution.** 
 Given a scoped problem and an agreed approach, you take it to production on your own — build, eval, deploy, monitor — without needing to be unblocked daily.
 



**Deep ownership of eval frameworks and working knowledge of associated services/infra.** 
 You go deep on the AI side of the product — models, evals, speech quality — and know enough about the surrounding services to trace a live problem across the pipeline and see it through.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 




 Build and maintain LLM/speech eval frameworks for the voicebot — task success, hallucination, instruction\-following, WER/latency, barge\-in and turn\-taking quality — across model and prompt changes.
 



 Run fine\-tuning experiments (full FT, PEFT/LoRA/QLoRA) on open\-weight models for domain\-specific voicebot tasks, and produce the evidence for when fine\-tuning beats prompting.
 



 Benchmark LLMs and ASR/TTS engines on cost, latency, and quality across providers and self\-hosted options — and make a clear recommendation from the data.
 



 Diagnose and fix real production conversation failures — bad turn\-taking, misrecognition, latency spikes, prompt regressions — using logs, traces, and eval data, not guesswork.
 



 Ship changes into the live conversational pipeline, with instrumentation and alerting built in from day one.
 



 Take ownership across the SDLC for your changes: design (with a senior engineer), eval design, deployment, and monitoring.
 



  





**What You Bring** 




**Must\-have** 




 Solid grounding in ANNs and transformer architecture — attention, tokenization, decoding strategies — enough to reason about why a model behaves a certain way, not just call an API.
 



 Hands\-on experience with LLM evals: building or running eval harnesses, LLM\-as\-judge setups, regression suites for prompt/model changes.
 



 Hands\-on experience with fine\-tuning, including PEFT/LoRA/QLoRA — on at least one open\-weight model, for a real task (not just a tutorial).
 



 Working knowledge of speech/ASR\-TTS evaluation — WER, latency, diarization, common failure modes in real (noisy, accented, multilingual) audio.
 



 Strong Python; comfortable reading/writing production code, not just notebooks.
 



 2\-4 years of software/ML engineering experience, with at least some of it in a production system (not purely research/academic).
 



 A track record of shipping and owning your own changes in production — you've been on the hook for something live.
 



 Strong analytical rigor — you instinctively ask "how do we measure this" before shipping a change.
 



  





**Good\-to\-have** 




 Experience with real\-time audio/streaming systems and streaming vs. batch tradeoffs.
 



 Experience with agentic orchestration and tool\-calling patterns for LLMs.
 



 Exposure to RAG patterns — embeddings, vector stores, retrieval strategies.
 



 Familiarity with self\-hosting/serving open\-weight models.
 



 Familiarity with observability for AI workloads — cost tracking, quality dashboards.
 



 Experience with multi\-tenant SaaS constraints (per\-tenant config, isolation).
 



 Prior experience specifically in voice AI / IVR / contact\-center domains.
 



  





**How We Work** 




 You own it. Build, eval, ship, monitor — and stay on the hook when it's running live. There's no separate "MLOps team" to hand off to.
 



 You measure it. No model or prompt change ships without an eval story behind it.
 



 You collaborate. You'll work closely with the voicebot architecture/product team and field delivery engineers shipping to enterprise customers. Good ideas win regardless of source.
 



 You stay curious. New models and techniques land constantly — evaluating and benchmarking new options is part of the job, not a side project.
 



  





**Why Exotel** 




 Work on AI problems at real scale: live voice conversations, not offline batch jobs, for enterprise customers.
 



 Strong senior engineers to design with, and real ownership of what you build.
 



 A team that treats "does it actually work" as more important than "does it demo well."
 



 Opportunity to work across the full voicebot AI stack: LLMs, speech, real\-time orchestration, and the infra it runs on.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
**About YugabyteDB\-** 




  





 YugabyteDB is a distributed SQL database built for cloud\-native applications that require scalability, high availability, and strong consistency. We work on challenging problems at the intersection of
 **distributed systems, databases, cloud infrastructure, and modern application development** 
 .
 



 We are looking for a
 **technically versatile, curious, and highly proactive engineer** 
 who enjoys solving problems across boundaries rather than being limited to a single technology or component.
 



 This role is ideal for someone who combines
 **strong engineering fundamentals with a growth mindset, excellent communication, and a willingness to experiment and learn quickly** 
 .
 



  





**What You’ll Do\-** 




  





 As a Software Engineer, you will work on a broad range of technical and product challenges across the
 **YugabyteDB ecosystem and Meko (mekodata.ai)** 
 . The problems you work on will evolve over time — and that is intentional.
 



**Meko is our AI\-focused product initiative, giving engineers an opportunity to work hands\-on with modern AI technologies and build real\-world AI\-powered experiences.** 




 You will:
 


* Design, build, debug, and improve software across different parts of the
 **YugabyteDB and Meko ecosystems** 
 .
* Work across areas such as
 **distributed systems, databases, cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, APIs, developer tooling, automation, and AI** 
 .
* Contribute to building and evolving
 **Meko** 
 , including AI\-powered products, experiences, and developer capabilities.
* Investigate complex technical problems and drive them from problem identification through implementation and delivery.
* Prototype new ideas, evaluate emerging technologies, and turn promising experiments into production\-quality solutions.
* Identify opportunities to improve engineering productivity, reliability, automation, and customer experience.
* Use
 **AI and AI\-assisted development** 
 to accelerate engineering workflows, troubleshoot complex problems, automate repetitive tasks, and explore new product capabilities.
* Collaborate with engineers, product managers, architects, support, and customers to understand problems and develop practical solutions.
* Take ownership of projects with ambiguous requirements and bring clarity, structure, and momentum to them.
* Learn new technologies and domains quickly and apply them to real\-world problems.



  





**What We’re Looking For\-** 




  





**Technical Skills\-** 




 We are looking for a
 **generalist engineer with strong fundamentals** 
 rather than someone who knows only one technology deeply.
 



 You should have:
 


* Strong programming and software engineering fundamentals.
* Experience with one or more languages such as
 **Python, Go, Java, C\+\+, or Rust** 
 .
* Good understanding of several areas such as:
* Distributed systems
* Databases and data management
* Cloud infrastructure
* Containers and Kubernetes
* Linux and systems engineering
* Observability, debugging, and performance
* APIs and application development
* Experience building and operating production\-quality software.
* Strong problem\-solving and debugging skills.
* Ability to understand unfamiliar codebases and technologies quickly.
* Familiarity with modern
 **AI/LLM technologies** 
 and an interest in applying them to engineering and/or product problems.
* Comfort working across the stack when the problem requires it.



  





 Experience with modern frontend technologies such as
 **JavaScript/TypeScript, React, HTML, and CSS** 
 is a plus, particularly for engineers interested in building end\-to\-end product experiences.
 



  





 You don’t need to be an expert in every technology listed above.
 **Curiosity, strong fundamentals, technical breadth, and the ability to learn quickly are more important than matching every item.** 




  





**Growth Mindset \& Agility\-** 




  





 We value engineers who actively seek to grow and are comfortable operating in an environment where priorities and problems evolve.
 



 You should:
 


* Be excited about learning technologies outside your current area of expertise.
* Be comfortable saying
 *“I don’t know”* 
 and then figuring it out.
* Seek feedback and use it to improve.
* Treat difficult problems as opportunities to learn.
* Experiment, iterate, and learn from failures.
* Move quickly from
 **idea → prototype → feedback → implementation** 
 .
* Proactively identify problems and opportunities rather than waiting for them to be assigned.



  





**Communication \& Collaboration\-** 




  





 Technical ability alone isn’t enough for this role.
 



 We are looking for someone who:
 


* Communicates clearly and proactively.
* Can explain complex technical concepts to different audiences.
* Works effectively with engineering and non\-engineering teams.
* Shares knowledge and helps others succeed.
* Can constructively challenge existing approaches and contribute their own ideas.
* Is comfortable working with ambiguity and changing priorities.



 We particularly value candidates who can demonstrate
 **strong communication, collaboration, and adaptability through their previous work and experiences** 
 .
 



  





**AI \& Innovation\-** 




  





 AI is changing both how software is built and how products are created.
 



 Through
 **YugabyteDB and Meko** 
 , you will have opportunities to explore and apply AI in practical engineering and product scenarios.
 



 This could include:
 


* Using AI coding assistants and agents to improve engineering productivity.
* Building AI\-powered developer and operational tooling.
* Exploring
 **LLMs, AI agents, MCP, RAG** 
 , and related technologies.
* Building AI\-powered product capabilities through
 **Meko** 
 .
* Applying AI to database operations, troubleshooting, observability, and automation.
* Identifying new ways AI can improve the YugabyteDB and Meko user experience.



 You don’t need to be an AI specialist.
 **You need to be curious about AI and willing to learn, experiment, and apply it.** 




  





**What Success Looks Like\-** 




  





 You will be successful if you:
 


* Take ownership of ambiguous problems and drive them to resolution.
* Become productive quickly in unfamiliar technical areas.
* Deliver meaningful improvements across technology and team boundaries.
* Proactively identify opportunities and turn them into outcomes.
* Contribute meaningfully to both
 **YugabyteDB and Meko** 
 .
* Communicate effectively and collaborate across teams.
* Continuously expand your technical breadth and depth.
* Use emerging technologies, including AI, to improve how we build and operate software.



  





**Why This Role?** 




  





 This role is for engineers who don’t want their growth to be constrained by a narrow job description.
 



 You will work on challenging problems involving
 **distributed databases, cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, developer tooling, AI, and large\-scale systems** 
 .
 



 At the same time, you will have the opportunity to
 **help build Meko, an AI\-focused product initiative** 
 , and gain hands\-on experience with technologies such as
 **LLMs, AI agents, MCP, RAG, and AI\-native applications** 
 .
 



 The role combines
 **deep technology with product building** 
 , giving you the opportunity to develop breadth across systems, cloud, applications, and AI while working with a highly collaborative engineering team.
 



 If you are
 **curious, adaptable, technically strong, proactive, and excited by problems that don’t always have obvious answers** 
 , we’d like to hear from you.

 .
