title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
 Abstrabit is a Private AI engineering company building AI\-powered products and solutions for businesses. We work across the AI stack — from deploying and evaluating private and open\-weight models to building production applications, agents, workflows, and integrations on top of them.
   

  

 Our engineering work is organized across two closely connected layers: the
 **AI layer** 
 , focused on models, inference, evaluation, and AI infrastructure; and the
 **application layer** 
 , focused on building reliable, scalable software products that use those AI capabilities.
   

  

**Job Description**
**The Context**
 AI systems become valuable only when the applications around them are reliable, maintainable, and well designed.
   

  

 That requires more than feature development. It requires good technical judgment around architecture, APIs, data models, integrations, reliability, security, observability, and how application systems should interact with AI inference services.
   

  

 Our Senior Software Engineers help own this application layer.
   

  

 We are looking for engineers who can take an ambiguous product or technical problem, turn it into a clear implementation plan, make sound design decisions, and guide the team through delivery.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a
 **Senior Software Engineer** 
 , you will take ownership of significant parts of the application layer of our AI products.
   

  

 You will design and build production systems, lead implementation of complex features, make architecture and technology decisions, solve difficult production problems, and help other engineers deliver high\-quality software.
   

  

 You will work across technologies such as
 **TypeScript, Node.js, React, Next.js, databases, APIs, cloud infrastructure, and distributed application components** 
 , while collaborating closely with our AI engineering team.
   

  

 This role is suited for an engineer who is comfortable operating with incomplete information, making practical trade\-offs, and taking responsibility for a system beyond the code they personally write.
   

  

**What You'll Work On**
 Depending on the project, you may work on:
   

  

* Designing and building major frontend and backend components.
* Turning product requirements into technical designs and implementation plans.
* Designing APIs, data models, workflows, and service boundaries.
* Integrating application systems with AI inference services, RAG systems, agents, and other AI capabilities.
* Making architecture decisions around scalability, reliability, security, and maintainability.
* Debugging complex issues across application, infrastructure, database, and integration layers.
* Reviewing code and technical designs from other engineers.
* Improving testing, observability, deployment, and engineering practices.
* Guiding Software Engineers and Interns through technical decisions and implementation challenges.
* Working with AI engineers to define clean interfaces between the model layer and the application layer.
* Identifying technical risks early and proposing practical ways to address them.
* Taking ownership of production systems after release, not just during development.


 Qualifications
   

  

 We are looking for engineers with strong technical judgment and a track record of owning production software.
   

  

**You should have:**
* At least 3 years of hands\-on full\-stack software development experience, with experience designing, building, and maintaining production applications across frontend and backend.
* Strong software engineering and problem\-solving fundamentals.
* Experience designing, building, and maintaining production web applications.
* Strong understanding of backend systems, APIs, databases, and modern application architecture.
* Ability to work effectively across frontend and backend when required.
* Experience making technical design decisions and explaining the trade\-offs behind them.
* Strong debugging skills across multiple layers of a system.
* Good understanding of testing, reliability, performance, security, and observability.
* Ability to review code and improve the technical quality of work produced by others.
* Ability to break ambiguous problems into clear, executable engineering tasks.
* Clear communication with engineers, product teams, and other stakeholders.
* A strong sense of ownership for systems from design through production.


 Experience with React, Next.js, Node.js, TypeScript, AWS, AI integrations, or distributed systems is useful, but we care more about depth of engineering judgment than an exact stack match.
   

  

**Using AI as an Engineer**
 We use AI tools as part of our engineering workflow, and we expect senior engineers to use them effectively. We do not evaluate senior engineers based on how much code they can write without assistance.
   

  

 What matters is whether you can
 **evaluate generated solutions, recognize weak designs, identify hidden risks, test assumptions, debug complex failures, and make better technical decisions than the tool alone can make.**
 At this level, AI should increase your leverage. It should not replace your judgment.
   

  

 Additional Information
   

  

**What This Role Is Not**
 This is
 **not an AI research or model\-engineering role** 
 .
   

  

 Your primary responsibility will be the application and product layer, while working closely with engineers responsible for model deployment, inference, evaluation, and AI infrastructure.
   

  

 This role isn't just about implementing tickets.
   

  

 You will be expected to question requirements when needed, identify missing technical considerations, propose better approaches, and help shape how systems are built.
   

  

 Nor is this purely an individual\-contributor coding role.
   

  

 You will still write substantial code, but part of your responsibility is to improve the quality and effectiveness of the engineers working around you.
   

  

**Why Join Abstrabit**
 You will work on production systems where modern software engineering meets Private AI.
   

  

 You will:
   

  

* Design applications that interact directly with private and open\-weight AI models.
* Work on technically complex systems spanning application engineering, cloud infrastructure, integrations, and AI.
* Influence architecture and engineering practices rather than only implement predefined solutions.
* Work closely with AI engineers on the boundary between inference systems and production applications.
* Own meaningful systems and technical decisions.
* Mentor and guide engineers while continuing to remain hands\-on.
* Gain deeper exposure to how production AI systems are designed and operated end to end.


**Our Interview Process \-** 
 Our hiring process is designed to evaluate technical judgment, ownership, and how you approach real engineering problems.
   

  

**Step 1: Application Screening \-** 
 We review your experience, projects, and evidence that you have built and shipped meaningful software.
   

  

**Step 2: Engineering Assessment \-** 
 You will complete a practical engineering exercise based on the type of problems you may encounter at Abstrabit.
   

  

 AI tools are allowed. We care about correctness, maintainability, edge cases, technical decisions, and how you structure a solution, not how much code you can produce from memory.
   

  

**Step 3: Technical Discussion \-** 
 You will discuss your solution and broader engineering decisions with our team. We may introduce changing requirements, production constraints, scaling concerns, failures, or alternative architectures and ask you to reason through them.
   

  

 This discussion is intended to evaluate system thinking, debugging ability, trade\-off analysis, and technical judgment.
   

  

**Step 4: Final Conversation \-** 
 A discussion about your experience, ownership expectations, ways of working, growth, and whether Abstrabit is the right environment for you.

title: Software Engineer 2
description:
**Life at UiPath**
 The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category\-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power.
   

  

 To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self\-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast\-moving, fast\-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose.
   

  

 Could that be you?
   

  

**About The Role**
 Join the Vertical Solutions team and build UiPath's most ambitious product \- an AI agentic orchestration platform that's been recognized as our Invention of the Year for two consecutive years. As a Software Engineer II, you'll be at the forefront of our Act 2 strategy, building the infrastructure that allows enterprises to seamlessly orchestrate AI agents, robots, and human\-in\-the\-loop workflows to achieve critical business outcomes.
   

  

 You'll be working with Lax and the Maestro backend team to build the core orchestration engine that powers enterprise AI automation. This is a high\-visibility, high\-impact role on UiPath's biggest strategic bet.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Build and Scale: Design, develop, and maintain full stack for Vertical Solutions products leveraging AI Coding Assistants.
* Hands\-On Development: Write production\-quality code daily, leveraging AI tools (Claude, GitHub Copilot, etc.) to enhance your development workflow
* Prototype and Ship: Take ideas from Prototype to validate with real customers and turn the ones that prove value into production systems.
* Measure what matters: Design evaluations, measure quality against real customer data, and understand when metrics mislead. Our systems are often non\-deterministic. Responsible shipping means measuring honestly, not chasing vanity numbers.
* Customer\-Centric Engineering: Deeply understand who will use the features you build and why they need them, translating customer needs into elegant technical solutions
* Ensure Reliability: Contribute to building highly scalable, reliable distributed systems that enterprises depend on.


**What We're Looking For**
* Builder mindset — you enjoy turning ideas into working systems and taking ownership from Concept through, Customer impact and Production
* Strong full stack knowledge including frontend systems like React and backend systems \-Python and/or C\# — most Vertical Solutions product development is Python (agents, APIs, ETL), while core platform work includes C\#, frontend in React. Willingness to work across both is important.
* Experience building production AI systems — LLMs, tool\-calling, multi\-agent architectures, orchestration frameworks (LangGraph, LangChain, or equivalent), structured outputs, orchestration, and evaluation of model behavior in real\-world workflows
* Distributed systems experience — designing resilient systems with idempotency, replay ability, state management, and long\-running jobs
* Strong analytical thinking — able to reason quantitatively about system quality and make sound decisions using imperfect signals
* Comfortable with ambiguity and rapid prototyping — able to move from idea to proof\-of\-concept quickly and iterate based on customer feedback.
* Experience with healthcare Tech/ Finance Tech/ Procurement Tech systems experience will be a big plus.


**What You'll Bring To The Team**
* Bachelor's/Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science or equivalent experience.
* 3\+ years of software engineering experience and focused on distributed systems and backend architecture.
* Strong proficiency in one or more system\-level languages – Javascript / C\# / Java etc
* Full\-stack experience: ability to work across backend services and frontend layers (REST/GraphQL APIs, basic UI integration, component contracts).
* Deep understanding of object\-oriented programming, architectural design patterns, system design, and data structures \& algorithms.
* Experience with React, TypeScript, or other modern frontend frameworks for deeper full\-stack contribution.
* Strong grasp of multithreading, asynchronous programming, synchronization, and cloud\-native programming models.
* Hands\-on experience with cloud ecosystems: Azure, AWS, or GCP.
* Proficiency with containerization and orchestration: Docker, Kubernetes, or equivalent.
* Hands\-on experience with AI coding tools and coding agents (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, or similar) and a demonstrated ability to integrate these into daily engineering workflows.
* Experience driving team adoption of AI\-powered productivity tools – setting norms, measuring impact, and iterating on usage patterns.
* Familiarity with modern engineering practices: agile development, CI/CD, DevOps, and infrastructure as code.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills; proven success collaborating with globally distributed teams and managing complex, time\-bound deliverables.
* Ability to understand, communicate, and drive complex technical decisions with stakeholders at all levels.


**Nice to Have**
* Experience with healthcare Tech/ Finance Tech/ Procurement Tech systems experience will be a big plus.
* Data science and evaluation
* Experience with applied ML techniques such as classification, anomaly detection, ranking, or predictive modeling
* Experience evaluating AI systems using experimentation, metrics, and empirical analysis to improve quality and reliability
* Data and retrieval systems
* Experience with large\-scale data platforms (Snowflake, columnar warehouses, denormalized data models)
* Familiarity with retrieval\-heavy architectures, RAG systems, or citation\-grounded AI workflows
* Engineering for trustworthy AI
* Experience blending deterministic and probabilistic systems (rules engines \+ AI)
* Experience designing eval\-driven systems, regression testing for LLM outputs, or human\-in\-the\-loop review workflows
* Platform and product development
* Frontend familiarity (React, TypeScript)
* Workflow orchestration platforms (Temporal, Airflow, Maestro, BPMN, Step Functions)
* Kubernetes and distributed infrastructure
* Experience in startups, applied research, or 0→1 product environments
* Open\-source contributions


**How We Work**
 Vertical Solutions operates like an internal startup inside UiPath: small teams, fast iteration, and real customers in the loop. We build quickly, test ideas with users, and turn the best ones into products. Some ideas won’t make it — that’s expected. You’ll work in short cycles, demo frequently, and adapt as we learn. We care more about solving the right problem than protecting a plan that no longer fits. If you enjoy ambiguity, rapid feedback, and building where product boundaries move fast, you’ll likely thrive here.
   

  

**Why Join Us**
* Work on cutting\-edge AI technology that's shaping the future of enterprise automation
* Be part of a team building Times top 100 Invention of the Year (2 years running)
* Collaborate with talented engineers who value rapid iteration and customer impact
* Contribute to UiPath's Act 2 strategy \- our most important product initiative


 Maybe you don’t tick all the boxes above—but still think you’d be great for the job? Go ahead, apply anyway. Please. Because we know that experience comes in all shapes and sizes—and passion can’t be learned.
   

  

 Many of our roles allow for flexibility in when and where work gets done. Depending on the needs of the business and the role, the number of hybrid, office\-based, and remote workers will vary from team to team. Applications are assessed on a rolling basis and there is no fixed deadline for this requisition. The application window may change depending on the volume of applications received or may close immediately if a qualified candidate is selected.
   

  

 We value a range of diverse backgrounds, experiences and ideas. We pride ourselves on our diversity and inclusive workplace that provides equal opportunities to all persons regardless of age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, and expression, national origin, disability, neurodiversity, military and/or veteran status, or any other protected classes. Additionally, UiPath provides reasonable accommodations for candidates on request and respects applicants' privacy rights. To review these and other legal disclosures, visit our privacy policy.

title: Software Engineer (SDE 3) - Agentic Workflows
description:
About Bytebeam
 
 Bytebeam builds connected\-vehicle infrastructure and is developing a fleet\-management application that brings live telemetry, diagnostics, alerts, actions, and operational data into one working system.
 


 Role Overview
 
 We are looking for a senior engineer to build reliable agentic workflows for fleet operations and internal engineering processes. This is not a prompt\-only role. You will design software where models use well\-defined tools, retrieve the right operational context, ask for approval when needed, and produce actions that can be evaluated, audited, and trusted.
 


 What You'll Do
 * Build agent\-assisted workflows that help users investigate vehicle issues, understand fleet state, prepare reports, and complete repetitive operational tasks.
* Design typed tools and service interfaces over telemetry, alerts, actions, documentation, and fleet\-domain data.
* Implement orchestration, state management, retrieval, guardrails, retries, and human\-in\-the\-loop approval.
* Create offline and online evaluation suites covering task success, factuality, safety, latency, and cost.
* Instrument traces and feedback loops so failures can be reproduced and improved systematically.
* Defend workflows against prompt injection, over\-broad permissions, unsafe tool use, and ambiguous user intent.
* Partner with backend, frontend, QA, product, and domain experts to move prototypes into dependable product experiences.
* Make practical decisions about when deterministic software is better than a model.


 Must\-Have Skills
 * 5\+ years of software engineering experience building production backend or full\-stack systems.
* Strong proficiency in Rust or Go
* Experience integrating LLM APIs or building tool\-using, retrieval\-augmented, or workflow\-oriented AI systems.
* Solid understanding of API design, databases, asynchronous work, testing, observability, and production reliability.
* Ability to design evaluation datasets and diagnose failures beyond subjective demos.
* Clear written communication and strong product judgment.


 Good\-to\-Have
 * Experience with fleet operations, IoT, telematics, customer support, or incident\-investigation workflows.
* Familiarity with vector/search systems, structured generation, workflow engines, or model routing.
* Experience with permission models, audit logs, PII controls, red teaming, or AI security.
* Contributions to developer tools, AI infrastructure, or evaluation frameworks.


 What Success Looks Like
 * You ship a small set of high\-value workflows that users repeatedly trust, with measurable task success, controlled permissions, predictable cost and latency, and a clear path from every production failure to an improved test.

title: SDE III - Engineering Productivity (AI)
description:
Most boards and executives are currently flying blind when it comes to cyber risk. They are guessing. At Safe, we’ve built an AI\-driven engine that finally gives the C\-Suite a clear, quantified, and real\-time view of their security posture. We don’t just provide data; we provide
 **certainty** 
 .
 



  





 We are a
 **$170M Series C\-funded** 
 category leader. We don’t play in the mid\-market; we operate at the highest levels of global enterprise. Today, we are proud to
 **serve 10% of the Fortune 500** 
 , protecting global icons such as
 **Apple, Netflix, AT\&T, Verizon, and Victoria’s Secret** 
 .
 



 As we scale toward our next chapter, we are looking for high\-performers who want to do the best work of their careers at the intersection of AI and Cybersecurity.
 



**The Culture Memo: Our Operating System** 




  





 Safe is not a typical corporate environment. We are a high\-intensity, mission\-driven team. We value builders who want to define a category and work alongside people who are equally committed to excellence.
 


* **Extreme Ownership:** 
 We don’t do "not my job." We hire people who see a gap and own the solution from start to finish.
* **The Elite Standard:** 
 We serve the most sophisticated companies on the planet. Our work must be bulletproof. Whether it’s a line of code or a sales deck, we aim for Tier\-1 quality every time.
* **Methodology \& Rigor:** 
 We don’t wing it. From
 **Force Management** 
 and
 **MEDDICC** 
 in sales to
 **data\-driven sprints** 
 in engineering, we rely on proven frameworks to stay disciplined and predictable.
* **Radical Candor:** 
 We move too fast for politics or sugar\-coating. We value direct, honest feedback that helps us find the right answer quickly.
* **The Series C Hustle:** 
 We have the stability of a well\-funded leader but the heart of a startup.



  





**The Perks \& Ownership:** 




 We want our team to feel like owners because they
 **are** 
 owners. We trust our people to manage their results and their time.
 


* **Meaningful Equity:** 
 Every "Safestar" is a shareholder. You aren’t just an employee; you are a partner in our success.
* **Unlimited Leaves:** 
 We don’t believe in clock\-watching. We offer
 **unlimited leave** 
 because we trust you to take the time you need to recharge while staying committed to the mission.
* **Comprehensive Benefits:** 
 We provide top\-tier medical insurance and wellness benefits to ensure you and your family are well cared for.
* **Career Trajectory:** 
 We are growing aggressively. For high\-performers, the path for advancement moves at the speed of your ambition.



  





 This role exists to change how engineering at Safe gets work done — not to add AI tools on top of today's workflow, but to rebuild the engineering operating model around AI, automation, and redesigned process, and to prove the gain in numbers.
 



  





 You will look across the full lifecycle — requirements, design, implementation, review, testing, deployment, operations, incidents, documentation — find where engineers lose time, and decide what actually fixes it: an AI agent, an automation, a platform capability, or a process change. Then build it to production quality, drive adoption, and measure whether cycle time moved.
 



  





 This is not a Developer Experience, DevOps, or internal\-tools role. It is a software engineering role whose product is engineering throughput.
 



  





**Why This Role Exists** 




 Engineering output is the constraint on how fast we ship against Fortune 500 demand. AI can lift it — but most organizations bolt AI onto unchanged workflows and get a chat window. The leverage is in redesigning the workflow around what AI can now do, putting agents inside CI, review, testing, and incident response, giving them real engineering context, and setting guardrails so engineers move fast without lowering the bar.
 



  





 The objective is not AI adoption. It is materially higher engineering output, speed, and quality.
 



  





**What You'll Do:** 



* ind the bottlenecks: Instrument how engineering time is actually spent — cycle time, review latency, CI failures, test authoring, operational toil, onboarding — and rank problems by recoverable hours.
* Pick the right instrument: Decide per bottleneck whether the answer is AI, automation, conventional software, or process change. Reject AI where it's the wrong tool.
* Apply AI across the lifecycle: AI\-assisted development and refactoring, first\-pass code review, test generation and suite optimization, automated documentation and release notes, design analysis, automated migrations, AI\-assisted debugging, incident investigation, and root\-cause analysis.
* Build engineering agents: Agents that diagnose CI failures, investigate production issues, write tests, run dependency upgrades, propose security fixes, analyze PRs, and execute repetitive migrations — human\-in\-the\-loop by default, autonomy earned per workflow.
* Redesign the process: Rework code review, testing, CI, and incident management for a world where AI does the first pass — and define what stays human\-owned and where approval is mandatory.
* Build the platform: AI gateway, agent runtime and workflow orchestration, codebase intelligence, engineering context retrieval, and deep Git/CI/observability/ticketing integrations — plus APIs and SDKs so teams build their own AI workflows on it.
* Solve the context problem: Give agents permission\-aware access to code, architecture docs, service ownership, deployment state, telemetry, incidents, and standards — and own retrieval quality and freshness.
* Set the guardrails: Quality, security, privacy, access control, approval gates, auditability, and evaluation for AI\-generated change.
* Prove the impact and drive adoption: Baseline, experiment, publish results, kill what doesn't move the metric, and mentor teams into the patterns that work.



  





**How We Measure Success:** 




 Not by tools built, experiments run, LLM calls, or chatbot users. By outcomes: reduced cycle time and repetitive work, faster PR review and CI failure resolution, fewer escaped defects, faster incident diagnosis, less operational toil, shorter onboarding, higher deployment frequency and throughput, and real adoption of AI workflows.
 



  





**What We're Looking For:** 



* 6\+ years building production software, with SDE3\-level ownership of systems in production.
* Strong Python, Java, Go, or equivalent — you ship production services and review others' code.
* Solid distributed systems, API and microservice, and software architecture grounding.
* Hands\-on cloud infrastructure and CI/CD experience.
* Demonstrated developer tooling and automation work that other engineers actually used.
* Practical experience with LLMs and agentic systems in real systems, not only experiments.
* Ability to reason quantitatively about workflows: baseline, hypothesis, experiment, measured result.
* Strong writing and the ability to influence engineering teams without authority.



  





**Nice to Have** 




 LLM APIs and model orchestration · production AI agents with tool use · RAG, retrieval, and vector databases · MCP or similar tool/context protocols · LLM evaluation, prompt and context engineering, AI observability · GitHub/GitLab APIs and deep CI/CD integration · Kubernetes and cloud platforms · internal developer platforms · DORA/SPACE\-style engineering measurement · security or compliance\-bound environments.
 



  





**SDE3 Expectations** 




 Not an execution\-only role. You identify org\-wide productivity problems without being handed a backlog, work across teams, read both technical and process bottlenecks, build for scale rather than prototypes, influence without authority, prove improvements quantitatively, and mentor engineers into AI\-first ways of working.
 



  





**What Success Looks Like:** 



* In 90 days: Engineering time\-spend is baselined, top bottlenecks are quantified in recoverable hours, and the first automation is shipped and in use.
* AI does the first pass: Code review, test generation, and CI failure diagnosis run through AI workflows by default; humans review judgment, not mechanics.
* Cycle time drops measurably quarter over quarter, attributable to specific changes.
* Agents carry real load across defined workflows, with approval gates, audit trails, and tracked reliability — while escaped defects and security findings do not rise.



  





 If you’re passionate about cyber risk, thrive in a fast\-paced environment, and want to be part of a team that’s redefining security,
 **we want to hear from you!** 
 🚀

title: Principal Software Engineer, Toast Partner Connect
description:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.
   

  

 We're looking for a Principal Engineer to set the technical direction for our Partner Connect team, which owns how everything outside Toast connects to Toast. That includes the event infrastructure every team at Toast uses to publish data, the frameworks partners and customers use to integrate with restaurants through our APIs, and a new charter to make Toast the source of truth for all the data about the restaurants we serve.
   

  

 Your impact will run well past this team. The frameworks Partner Connect builds are what other Toast engineering teams use to expose their data and their events, so the patterns you set here become how dozens of teams ship for years afterward. Get that right and the entire platform moves faster. Few technical roles at Toast have that kind of reach into how other people build.
   

  

 You're someone who does your best work when the path isn't drawn yet. You write clearly, you build agreement across organizations rather than issuing mandates, and you treat the engineers who use your systems as customers whose experience matters. You'll be based in Bangalore, working with a small and growing team spread across Bangalore, Dublin, and Boston, and partnering closely with the engineering manager and product manager to turn a broad vision into work the team can actually deliver.
   

  

 Come own a domain that touches every Toast customer and every Toast engineer.
   

  

**A Day In The Life (Responsibilities)**
* Own the technical strategy for Partner Connect and make it legible to people well outside the team.
* Design the platform that lets strategic partners send us customer data, and the architecture for storing it and serving it to ToastIQ and our AI agents.
* Design the systems that make partner onboarding automated, self\-serve, and fast, including sandbox provisioning and a clean path to production.
* Set the frameworks, contracts, and standards other Toast teams use to publish events and expose APIs, and build the feedback loops that tell you whether those teams are succeeding.
* Build partnerships across Commerce, platform, and product organizations so the technical direction here aligns with where Toast is going.
* Partner with the engineering manager and product manager to turn vision into an executable roadmap, holding the balance between new architecture and the systems the team already runs in production.
* Raise the technical bar through architecture, design review, and code review, and mentor engineers across levels as the team grows.
* Guide the team to build for the next order of magnitude of scale, with the monitoring and operational maturity to match.
* Use AI tools in your own workflow and help establish how the team uses them well, including how to critically evaluate what they produce.


**What You'll Need To Thrive (Requirements)**
* 10\+ years designing and delivering complex, scalable backend systems, with a track record of technical leadership on work that mattered to the business.
* Demonstrated influence beyond your own team. You've driven a technical direction other teams adopted, and you can describe how you earned that.
* Deep experience with distributed, event\-driven architectures and APIs in Java, Kotlin, Scala, or a similar language, on a major cloud platform.
* Strong data architecture and schema design judgment. You've made modeling decisions that had to survive years of new requirements.
* Experience owning a platform or shared service with real internal consumers, and a point of view on how you knew whether those consumers were succeeding.
* Comfort starting from ambiguity. Parts of this charter have no playbook yet, and your first job is to write one.
* A customer\-first instinct that extends to developers. You care that an integration is pleasant to build against, not only that it's correct.
* Excellent written communication. At this level a clear design document is one of your highest\-value artifacts, especially on a team split across three time zones.
* Strong interpersonal skills. Respectful, empathetic, humble, and genuinely invested in making the engineers around you better.
* Comfortable using AI\-powered engineering tools to improve productivity, code quality, and technical decision making, with the judgment to validate what they generate. Experience championing responsible, secure AI adoption across engineering teams is a real plus.


**AI at Toast**
 At Toast, one of our company values is that we're hungry to build and learn. We believe learning new AI tools empowers us to build for our customers faster, more independently, and with higher quality. We provide these tools across all disciplines, from Engineering and Product to Sales and Support, and are inspired by how our Toasters are already driving real value with them. The people who thrive here are those who embrace changes that let us build more for our customers; it’s a core part of our culture.
   

  

**Our Total Rewards Philosophy**
 We strive to provide competitive compensation and benefits programs that help to attract, retain, and motivate the best and brightest people in our industry. Our total rewards package goes beyond great earnings potential and provides the means to a healthy lifestyle with the flexibility to meet Toasters’ changing needs. Learn more about our benefits at https://careers.toasttab.com/toast\-benefits.
   

  

**How Toast Uses AI In Its Hiring Process**
 Throughout the hiring process, our goal is to get to know you. We use AI tools to support our recruiters and interviewers with tasks like note\-taking, summarization, and documentation of interviews to ensure they can be fully focused on your conversation. All hiring decisions are made by people. We ask that you complete interviews and assessments on your own, without real\-time AI tools, recording, or transcription bots, unless we tell you otherwise in advance. To learn more: https://careers.toasttab.com/ai\-in\-hiring
   

  

**Our Approach to Hybrid Working**
 We embrace a hybrid work model that fosters in\-person collaboration while valuing individual needs. Our goal is to build a strong culture of connection as we work together to empower the hospitality community, regardless of location. Please visit the Locations page on our career site to learn more about our in\-office expectations by region: https://careers.toasttab.com/locations\-toast
   

  

**People Are the Secret Ingredient in Our Recipe for Success**
 At Toast, our employees are our secret ingredient—when they thrive, we thrive. The restaurant industry brings together people with a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we value that same breadth at Toast. We strive to build a culture grounded in authenticity, respect, and humility, where every Toaster has a real opportunity to grow, contribute, and do their best work—raising the bar in delivering exceptional experiences for our customers and each other.
   

  

**Apply today!**
 Toast is committed to creating an accessible and inclusive hiring process. As part of this commitment, we strive to provide reasonable accommodations for persons with disabilities to enable them to access the hiring process. If you need an accommodation to access the job application or interview process, please contact candidateaccommodations@toasttab.com.

title: Software Engineer I (SDE1)
description:
**Company Description**
 Abstrabit is a Private AI engineering company building AI\-powered products and solutions for businesses. We work across the AI stack — from deploying and evaluating private and open\-weight models to building production applications, agents, workflows, and integrations on top of them.
   

  

 Our engineering work is organized across two closely connected layers: the
 **AI layer** 
 , focused on models, inference, evaluation, and AI infrastructure; and the
 **application layer** 
 , focused on building reliable, scalable software products that use those AI capabilities.
   

  

**Job Description**
**The Context**
 AI models are only useful when they can be turned into reliable products.
   

  

 That requires strong application engineering — frontend and backend systems, APIs, workflows, integrations, authentication, databases, observability, and production infrastructure that can work reliably with AI inference services.
   

  

 Our Software Engineering team owns this application layer.
   

  

 We are looking for engineers who can independently deliver well\-defined features, understand the systems around them, and grow into broader ownership over time.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a
 **Software Engineer I (SDE1\)** 
 , you will work primarily on the application layer of our AI products and own scoped features from implementation through delivery.
   

  

 You will build frontend and backend functionality, APIs, integrations, workflows, and production services that use AI models and inference systems.
   

  

 You will work with technologies such as
 **TypeScript, Node.js, React, Next.js, databases, APIs, and cloud platforms** 
 , while collaborating closely with AI engineers and senior software engineers.
   

  

 This role is suited for someone who is comfortable taking a defined problem, breaking it down, building the solution, testing it, and taking responsibility for getting it into production.
   

  

**What You'll Work On**
 Depending on the project, you may work on:
   

  

* Building and owning frontend and backend product features.
* Designing and implementing APIs and internal services.
* Working with databases, authentication, queues, file storage, and third\-party integrations.
* Integrating applications with AI models, inference services, RAG systems, and AI agents.
* Debugging issues across frontend, backend, APIs, and infrastructure.
* Writing tests and improving application reliability.
* Participating in technical design discussions for the features you own.
* Deploying and monitoring applications on cloud platforms.
* Reviewing code and incorporating feedback from senior engineers.
* Working with AI engineers to convert model capabilities into usable product features.


 Qualifications
   

  

 We are looking for engineers who can independently deliver scoped work and have strong software engineering fundamentals.
   

  

 You should have:
   

  

* At least 1 year of hands\-on full\-stack software development experience, including experience building and shipping web applications across frontend and backend.
* Strong programming and problem\-solving fundamentals.
* Experience building and shipping web applications.
* Working knowledge of JavaScript or TypeScript and a modern frontend or backend framework.
* Good understanding of APIs, databases, Git, and common web application patterns.
* Ability to read an existing codebase and make changes safely.
* Ability to debug problems instead of treating symptoms.
* Understanding of basic testing and software quality practices.
* Ability to communicate clearly about implementation decisions, trade\-offs, and blockers.
* Experience owning a feature or meaningful part of a project from development through delivery.


 Experience with React, Next.js, Node.js, cloud platforms, AI integrations, or production systems is useful, but we care more about engineering fundamentals than an exact technology match.
   

  

**Using AI as an Engineer**
 We use AI tools as part of our engineering workflow, and you are welcome to use them. We do not evaluate engineers based on how much code they can write from memory.
   

  

 What matters is whether you can
 **understand the code you produce, evaluate alternative approaches, identify incorrect suggestions, test your implementation, debug failures, and take responsibility for the final result.**
 AI can accelerate your work. It does not replace engineering judgment.
   

  

**What This Role Is Not**
 This is
 **not an AI research or model\-engineering role** 
 .
   

  

 Your primary responsibility will be the application layer — building the software that turns AI capabilities into reliable products.
   

  

 You will work closely with the AI engineering team and gain exposure to model inference, RAG, evaluation, and Private AI infrastructure, but you will not be expected to own model training or deployment as your primary responsibility.
   

  

 Additional Information
   

  

**Why Join Abstrabit**
 You will work at the intersection of software engineering and Private AI.
   

  

 You will:
   

  

* Build production software that directly uses modern AI systems.
* Work across frontend, backend, APIs, databases, cloud infrastructure, and AI integrations.
* Learn how application systems interact with private and open\-weight models.
* Work closely with AI engineers and experienced software engineers.
* Own meaningful product features, not just isolated development tasks.
* Receive regular technical feedback and code reviews.
* Grow toward larger feature ownership and system\-level responsibilities as your engineering ability develops.


 Our Interview Process
   

  

 Our hiring process evaluates how you build and reason about software, not how closely your resume matches a list of keywords.
   

  

**Step 1: Application Screening \-** 
 We review your experience, projects, and evidence that you have built and shipped meaningful software.
   

  

**Step 2: Engineering Assessment \-** 
 You will complete a practical engineering exercise based on the kind of work you may encounter at Abstrabit.
   

  

 We care about implementation quality, how you handle edge cases, how you validate your solution, and whether you can make sensible engineering decisions.
   

  

**Step 3: Technical Discussion \-** 
 You will discuss your solution with our engineering team.
   

  

 We may ask you to explain your approach, identify problems in the implementation, debug an issue, modify part of the solution, or reason about an alternative design.
   

  

 The objective is to understand how you think when the problem moves beyond the initial specification.
   

  

**Step 4: Final Conversation \-** 
 A discussion about your experience, the role, expectations, growth, and whether Abstrabit is the right environment for you.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Travel Team
description:
**About Rippling**
 Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.
   

  

 Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.
   

  

 Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.8B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.
   

  

 We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.
   

  

**About The Role**
 You’ll be part of the Travel integrations team, helping to define the future of corporate travel through the Rippling Platform’s integrated solutions. As part of Rippling’s Spend Suite—which also includes corporate cards, expense management, procurement, and bill pay—the Travel team is integral to our all\-in\-one solution for managing corporate spending.
   

  

 Our customers value the seamless integration of corporate cards, expense management, and accounting automation, with travel management as the next frontier. Our mission is to build the best travel management platform for employees, finance teams, and travel managers alike.
   

  

****You will:****
* Collaborate with Product Management and other stakeholders within Engineering (Frontend, UX, etc.) to maintain a high bar for quality in a fast\-paced, iterative environment.
* Wear a product manager hat when needed.
* Build features that solve technical problems of high scope and complexity.
* Participate in planning activities, perform code reviews, and contribute to a growing team.
* Translate high\-level business requirements into a software design; communicate the designs to the other developers in the team.
* Provide mentorship for Junior and Intermediate Engineers on your team to help them grow in their technical responsibilities and remove blockers to their autonomy.


****Qualifications:****
* Minimum 6\+ years of programming experience
* Ability to exercise discretion and independent judgment in the performance of the duties
* Preferred experience in our technology stack\- Go, Python, Django, MongoDB, AWS
* Strong CS knowledge
* Ability to thrive in an ambiguous environment by identifying areas of impact and independently pursuing them.
* Experience in travel domain is \+ point.

title: Staff Software Engineer, AI/ML
description:
The Calix platform enables Communication Service Providers (CSPs) of all sizes to transform and future\-proof their businesses. Through real\-time data, automation, and actionable insights delivered via Calix One — our cloud\-first, AI\-powered platform — CSPs can simplify operations, collapse cost, and accelerate innovation. Calix One brings together the automation of everything and the experience of one, empowering customers to deliver differentiated subscriber experiences while driving acquisition, loyalty, and revenue growth. This is the Calix mission: to enable CSPs of all sizes to simplify, innovate, and grow, strengthening both their businesses and the communities they serve.
   

  

 We’re at the forefront of a once in a generational change in the broadband industry. Join us as we innovate, help our customers reach their potential, and connect underserved communities with unrivaled digital experiences.
   

  

 Calix is where passionate innovators come together with a shared mission: to reimagine broadband experiences and empower communities like never before. As a true pioneer in broadband technology, we ignite transformation by equipping service providers of all sizes with an unrivaled platform, state\-of\-the\-art cloud technologies, and AI\-driven solutions that redefine what’s possible. Every tool and breakthrough we offer is designed to simplify operations and unlock extraordinary subscriber experiences through innovation.
   

  

 We are looking for a passionate and skilled AI Agent Development Engineer to join our team and build intelligent, autonomous agents that transform workflows and customer experiences. This is a hands\-on role requiring strong technical expertise in AI agent frameworks and integration with enterprise systems.
   

  

 Please note that as part of the recruitment and hiring process, there is an in\-person meeting that will take place
 *.*
**Key Responsibilities**
* Design \& Build AI Agents: Develop and deploy agents capable of perception, reasoning, and autonomous action.
* Integration: Integrate agents with existing external systems using REST APIs, microservices, and cloud platforms.
* Optimization: Implement best practices for performance, scalability, and security in multi\-agent environments.
* Collaboration: Work with product managers and data scientists to align agent capabilities with business needs.
* Innovation: Explore emerging technologies in Generative AI, LLM orchestration, and multi\-agent frameworks.


**Required Skills \& Qualifications** 
 :
   

  

* 10\+ years in software development with exposure to AI/ML projects.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, AI/ML, or related field.
* Hands\-on experience in developing AI agents using frameworks like Google ADK, LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen, or similar.
* Strong programming skills in Go, Rust, or Python (experience with PL/SQL or Java is a plus).
* Familiarity with LLM integration, prompt engineering, and orchestration of multi\-agent workflows.
* Knowledge of vector databases, embeddings, and retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG).
* Understanding of Generative AI, NLP, and reinforcement learning concepts.


**Preferred:**
* Experience building custom AI agents for enterprise workflows (e.g., service request triage, summarization, proactive support).
* Working with agent lifecycle management and AI profiles for model selection and orchestration.
* Exposure to multi\-agent collaboration and autonomous decision\-making systems


**Why Join Us?**
* Be part of a team driving AI innovation in telecom and cloud solutions.
* Opportunity to work on cutting\-edge projects impacting millions of users.
* Collaborative culture with continuous learning and growth.
* Competitive Benefits and Vacation package.

 India – (Flexible hybrid work model \- work from Bangalore office for 20 days in a quarter).

**About Pine Labs** 




 Pine Labs is building technology that powers commerce at scale. We simplify commerce and enable businesses and financial institutions to create seamless payment and financial experiences.
 



 At Pine Labs, we believe
 **Every Day is Game Day** 
 . We move fast, take ownership, build with purpose, and continuously raise the bar on engineering excellence.
 



 About the Role
 



 We are looking for a
 **Software Engineer (QA)** 
 to join our engineering team and help us build reliable, scalable, and high\-quality products.
 



 In this role, you will work across
 **backend services, APIs, frontend applications, microservices, and data systems** 
 . You will be responsible for designing and implementing robust test automation strategies, identifying quality risks early, and ensuring that our systems perform reliably at scale.
 



 You will work closely with
 **Software Engineers, Product Managers, and DevOps teams** 
 to build quality into the development lifecycle rather than treating testing as a final step.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 



* Design, develop, and maintain automated test frameworks for backend APIs, microservices, and frontend applications.
* Build automated
 **functional, regression, integration, end\-to\-end, and smoke test suites** 
 .
* Develop and execute API automation for
 **REST and/or GraphQL services** 
 .
* Build UI automation using
 **Selenium, Cypress, Playwright** 
 , or equivalent frameworks.
* Design and execute

* Validate data across APIs, databases, backend services, queues, and frontend applications.
* Perform data quality testing covering
 **accuracy, completeness, consistency, and integrity** 
 .
* Investigate test failures, identify root causes, and work with engineering teams to resolve defects.
* Integrate automated tests into
 **CI/CD pipelines** 
 and enable continuous quality validation.
* Create and maintain test strategies, test plans, test cases, automation scripts, and quality documentation.
* Participate in architecture, design, and code reviews to identify potential quality risks early.
* Monitor application quality across development, QA, staging, and production environments.
* Define and track relevant quality metrics and communicate risks and issues to stakeholders.
* Continuously improve test automation frameworks, tools, processes, and engineering practices.



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* **4\+ years of experience** 
 in SDET, QA Automation, Software Testing, or a similar engineering role.
* Strong programming skills in
 **Java, Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, or C\#** 
 .
* Strong hands\-on experience with
 **backend/API and frontend/UI automation** 
 .
* Experience with automation frameworks/tools such as:
* Selenium
* Cypress
* Playwright
* REST Assured
* Postman
* or equivalent frameworks
* Hands\-on experience with
 **load and performance testing** 
 using tools such as JMeter, Gatling, LoadRunner, k6, or similar.
* Strong understanding of
 **SQL and database testing** 
 .
* Experience validating data across
 **APIs, databases, queues, and frontend systems** 
 .
* Good understanding of software development and testing methodologies, preferably
 **Agile/Scrum** 
 .
* Experience with
 **Git and CI/CD** 
 tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Azure DevOps.
* Strong analytical, debugging, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of quality across the product lifecycle.



  





**Good to Have** 



* Experience testing
 **microservices and distributed systems** 
 .
* Experience working with cloud platforms such as
 **AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud** 
 .
* Hands\-on experience with
 **Docker and Kubernetes** 
 .
* Familiarity with observability and monitoring tools such as
 **Grafana, Prometheus, ELK, or Datadog** 
 .
* Understanding of
 **security testing** 
 and performance engineering concepts.
* Experience with
 **message queues, event\-driven architectures, or data pipelines** 
 .
* Experience building or contributing to QA automation frameworks from the ground up.



  





**What Success Looks Like** 




 You will be successful in this role when you:
 


* Increase automation coverage and reduce manual regression effort.
* Identify and prevent defects early in the development lifecycle.
* Build reliable, scalable, and maintainable automated test suites.
* Improve the quality and reliability of data across systems.
* Help identify performance and scalability issues before they impact customers.
* Improve overall application stability and release confidence.
* Enable engineering teams to deliver high\-quality software consistently.



  





**Why Pine Labs?** 




 At Pine Labs, you will work on technology that powers commerce at scale and solve challenging engineering problems alongside talented teams.
 



 We believe in:
 


* **Taking the shot** 
 — decide fast and deliver right.
* **Signing your work like an artist** 
 — master your craft and take pride in what you build.
* **Being the Sherpa** 
 — lead, support, and grow together.
* **Being the CEO of what you do** 
 — take ownership and make things happen.
* **Caring with tough love** 
 — build relationships based on trust, respect, and openness.
* **Owning tomorrow** 
 — innovate for customers, the industry, and the future.



 If you enjoy solving complex quality problems, building automation at scale, and working closely with engineering teams to create reliable software,
 **we'd love to hear from you.**

description:

 Our mission is to architect AI that learns from and interacts with the world like humans do.
   

  

 We're pioneering the model architectures that will make this possible. Our founding team met as PhDs at the Stanford AI Lab, where we invented State Space Models or SSMs, a new primitive for training efficient, large\-scale foundation models. Our team combines deep expertise in model innovation and systems engineering paired with a design\-minded product engineering team to build and ship cutting edge models and experiences.
   

  

 We're funded by leading investors at Index Ventures and Lightspeed Venture Partners, along with Factory, Conviction, A Star, General Catalyst, SV Angel, Databricks and others. We're fortunate to have the support of many amazing advisors, and 90\+ angels across many industries, including the world's foremost experts in AI.

 We’re opening our first ever office in India, and looking to hire for a Software Engineer to advance our mission of building real\-time multimodal intelligence.

* Design and build low latency, scalable, and reliable model inference and serving stack for our cutting edge SSM foundation models
* Work closely with our research team and product engineers to translate cutting edge research into incredible products

title: Senior Staff Developer - AI
description:
At
 **Arctic Wolf** 
 , you will not just watch the cybersecurity industry evolve – you will help lead the change. Our global team is made up of people who thrive on solving complex problems, moving quickly, and building technology that protects organizations around the world. We are proud to be recognized by Forbes, CNBC, Fortune, CRN, Gartner Peer Insights, and International Data Corporation MarketScape. What matters most is the work behind these recognitions: delivering real outcomes for customers through award\-winning innovation such as our Aurora Platform.
   

  

 If you are looking for meaningful work, smart teammates, and the opportunity to make a real impact in a high\-growth company that is redefining security operations, Arctic Wolf is the right place for you.
   

  

**Our mission is simple:** 
 End Cyber Risk.
   

  

 We are looking for a
 **Senior Staff Developer – AI** 
 to help achieve this mission.
   

  

 The Senior Staff Developer will contribute to our Engineering organization by designing, developing, and optimizing next\-generation artificial intelligence agent frameworks that power security operations automation. This role is focused on building sophisticated agentic systems capable of reasoning, planning, orchestration, tool usage, decision\-making, and autonomous task execution.
   

  

 As a senior technical leader, you will play a hands\-on role in defining and evolving the architecture of agentic artificial intelligence frameworks, improving agent performance and reliability, and developing reusable patterns that enable intelligent automation at scale. You will work closely with artificial intelligence and machine learning engineers, data scientists, security researchers, detection engineers, and security operations teams to transform complex operational requirements into intelligent, production\-ready agentic solutions.
   

  

**About Arctic Wolf Labs**
 Arctic Wolf Labs is the research\-focused division of Arctic Wolf dedicated to advancing innovation in security operations. Our mission is to develop cutting\-edge technologies and tools that strengthen Arctic Wolf’s core goal of ending cyber risk while bringing intelligence and automation to both our customers and the broader security community.
   

  

 You will collaborate with threat researchers, data scientists, detection engineers, platform developers, and security operations experts to build real\-world solutions for complex cybersecurity challenges.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Design, develop, and optimize agentic artificial intelligence frameworks that enable intelligent reasoning, planning, orchestration, and autonomous task execution.
* Build reusable agent architectures and framework components using technologies such as LangChain, LangGraph, LangSmith, or similar agentic frameworks.
* Develop multi\-agent workflows that enable agents to collaborate, delegate tasks, invoke tools, reason over context, and make decisions based on available information.
* Design and implement agent orchestration patterns, including state management, memory, tool calling, planning, routing, human\-in\-the\-loop workflows, and autonomous execution.
* Optimize agent performance, reliability, accuracy, latency, and cost through systematic evaluation, experimentation, and framework improvements.
* Develop evaluation frameworks and observability capabilities to measure agent behavior, reasoning quality, tool usage, task completion, and overall system effectiveness.
* Design and implement artificial intelligence powered automation workflows that transform complex Security Operations Center processes into scalable and intelligent agentic solutions.
* Integrate large language models, machine learning models, retrieval systems, tools, application programming interfaces, and enterprise services into agentic workflows.
* Research and prototype emerging agentic artificial intelligence techniques and translate successful approaches into production\-ready framework capabilities.
* Establish engineering patterns and best practices for prompt orchestration, agent evaluation, context management, guardrails, error handling, and autonomous decision\-making.
* Collaborate with artificial intelligence and machine learning, data science, security research, detection engineering, and security operations teams to identify opportunities for agentic automation.
* Drive technical leadership through architecture discussions, code reviews, technical design, mentoring, and development of engineering standards for agentic systems.
* Solve complex technical challenges related to agent behavior, orchestration, reasoning, evaluation, reliability, and production performance.


**You Will Be Successful In This Role If**
* You have 14 or more years of experience in software engineering, artificial intelligence engineering, machine learning engineering, or related technical development roles.
* You have deep hands\-on experience designing and developing artificial intelligence agents, agentic workflows, or intelligent automation systems.
* You have strong experience with agentic frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LangSmith, Semantic Kernel, or similar technologies.
* You have strong programming experience in Python, Go, or similar programming languages and can independently design, develop, debug, and optimize production\-quality software.
* You have experience working with large language models, prompt engineering, tool calling, retrieval\-augmented generation, agent orchestration, context management, and autonomous task execution.
* You have experience developing evaluation strategies and frameworks for artificial intelligence applications, including measuring accuracy, reliability, latency, cost, and agent task completion.
* You have strong understanding of distributed systems, application programming interfaces, event\-driven workflows, data processing, and software design patterns.
* You have demonstrated experience taking artificial intelligence prototypes from experimentation through production deployment and continuous optimization.
* You have demonstrated success leading complex technical initiatives, influencing architectural decisions, and establishing engineering best practices.
* You can independently drive large\-scale technical initiatives from concept and architecture through implementation, evaluation, and production adoption.
* You have strong communication, collaboration, and problem\-solving skills and can mentor engineers and influence technical direction across teams.


**Nice To Have**
* Experience building multi\-agent systems or Mixture of Experts architectures.
* Experience with LangGraph, LangChain, LangSmith, Model Context Protocol, or similar agentic artificial intelligence technologies.
* Experience building agent evaluation, tracing, observability, and experimentation frameworks.
* Experience with artificial intelligence and machine learning operations, including model evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
* Experience building intelligent automation systems for Security Operations Center, threat detection, incident response, or other complex operational environments.
* Familiarity with threat intelligence, detection engineering, security analytics, or cybersecurity workflows.
* Experience developing guardrails, validation mechanisms, and human\-in\-the\-loop controls for autonomous artificial intelligence systems.
* Experience contributing to technical strategy, architecture reviews, or engineering leadership initiatives.


**What Success Looks Like**
* Development and adoption of scalable agentic artificial intelligence frameworks that enable intelligent automation across security operations.
* Measurable improvements in agent accuracy, reliability, task completion, latency, and cost.
* Successful development of reusable agent architectures, orchestration patterns, tools, and framework components.
* Production adoption of large language model powered agents capable of reasoning, planning, tool usage, and autonomous task execution.
* Strong evaluation and observability capabilities that enable continuous optimization of agent performance.
* Increased automation of complex operational workflows through intelligent agentic systems.
* Strong technical mentorship and contribution to the growth and maturity of artificial intelligence engineering capabilities across the organization.


 Do not meet all the requirements? That is okay. We still encourage you to apply. We have many opportunities and are always looking for strong talent.
   

  

**On\-Camera Policy**
 To support a fair, transparent, and engaging interview experience, candidates interviewing remotely are expected to be on camera during all video interviews. Being on camera fosters authentic connection, improves communication, and allows for full engagement from both candidates and interviewers. We understand that technical, bandwidth, or location\-related challenges may occasionally prevent video use. If this applies, candidates are required to notify us in advance so we can explore appropriate accommodations.
   

  

 At Arctic Wolf, we foster a collaborative and inclusive work environment that thrives on diversity of thought, background, and culture. This is reflected in our multiple awards, including Top Workplace United States, Best Places to Work United States, Great Place to Work Canada, Great Place to Work United Kingdom, and Kununu Top Company Germany. Our commitment to bold growth and shaping the future of security operations is matched by our dedication to customer satisfaction, with over 10,000 customers worldwide and more than 2,000 channel partners globally. As we continue to expand and enhance our technology, Arctic Wolf remains a trusted name in the industry.
   

  

**Our Values**
 Arctic Wolf recognizes that success comes from delighting our customers, so we work together to ensure that happens every day. We believe in diversity and inclusion and value the unique perspectives all employees bring to the organization. By protecting sensitive data and working to end cyber risk, we contribute to an industry that serves the greater good.
   

  

 We celebrate diverse perspectives through our Pack Unity program and encourage employees to participate in or create new alliances.
   

  

 We also believe in corporate responsibility and have joined the Pledge One Percent movement to give back to our communities.
   

  

**All Employees Receive Compelling Compensation And Benefits Packages, Including**
* Equity for all employees
* Flexible annual leave, paid holidays, and volunteer days
* Training and career development programs
* Comprehensive private benefits plan including medical insurance for you and your family, life insurance equal to three times compensation, and personal accident insurance
* Fertility support and paid parental leave


 Arctic Wolf is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetics, or any other basis forbidden under applicable law. We are committed to fostering a welcoming, accessible, and inclusive environment.
   

  

**Security Requirements**
* Conduct duties in accordance with Arctic Wolf information security policies, standards, and controls.
* Background checks are required for this position.
* This role may require access to information protected under United States export control laws and regulations, including the Export Administration Regulations. If applicable, an offer of employment will be conditioned upon authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these regulations.

title: Senior Software Engineer ( Web crawling)
description:
**Mission** 




 If you ask a hospital today how much a treatment will cost, the answer is usually: “We don’t know.” Not because providers don’t want to tell you but because patient cost is computed across insurance plans, negotiated rates, and billing rules that are fragmented, opaque, and not designed for real\-time transparency. What should be a simple question requires navigating a web of systems that don’t talk to each other. So humans do that work instead. They log into portals, call payers, follow decision trees, and manually stitch together answers across disconnected systems. Even when providers want to give a clear answer, the system makes it nearly impossible. At Bravebird, we’re changing that. We’re building agents that do the work between systems \- end to end. We believe the future of work is machines talking to machines, handling fragmented, system\-to\-system workflows so humans can focus on decisions, judgment, and care.
 



**About The Role** 




 We're building agentic AI systems that can reason, act, and operate reliably in messy, real\-world environments. As a Software Engineer (Browser Automation), you will build the backbone that makes our agents reliable, scalable, and production\-ready. You'll write the automations that log into fragmented legacy portals, keep them durable when those portals change, and build the infrastructure that runs thousands of them at once. This is a deeply technical, high\-ownership role. You'll work directly with founders, shape the technical direction, and ship systems that are used in real\-world, high\-stakes environments.
 



**What You’ll Do** 



* Build Robust Automation Engines — highly reliable, code\-first browser automations navigating complex, fragmented legacy portals and extracting structured data.
* Build Self\-Healing Workflows — deterministic \+ AI\-assisted self\-healing that adapts to UI updates, layout shifts, and element mutations without human intervention.
* Scale Execution — concurrent, high\-throughput execution of thousands of long\-running workflows with strong state management, retries, low latency, high consistency.
* Architect Stealth Infrastructure — build and scale execution infrastructure using advanced stealth execution, browser fingerprinting, and residential proxy management to keep automations stable against portals that don't want to be automated.



**What You’ll Bring** 



* 5\+ years of software engineering experience — you ship production systems and build software.
* Web automation at scale (hard requirement) — a proven track record of building and maintaining production\-grade web automation or scraping systems at scale.
* Deep browser\-automation expertise — hands\-on mastery of Playwright, Puppeteer, Selenium, or CDP, plus the DOM, HTTP, headers, and session management.
* Stealth and proxy mastery — direct production experience with stealth execution, residential proxy management, and browser fingerprinting.
* Architectural rigor — strong thinking around state management, distributed queues, and retries for long\-running, non\-deterministic workflows.
* A resilient problem\-solving mindset — you enjoy reverse\-engineering obscure systems, finding stable workarounds, and building durable software for restrictive environments.



**What We Offer** 



* Ownership and impact
* Competitive compensation with meaningful equity
* Direct access to founders and customers
* The opportunity to ship production systems in high\-stakes environments

title: Senior Systems Software Engineer - NV Cloud Functions
description:
Job Requisition ID JR2025225
   

  

 Job Category Engineering
   

  

 Time Type Full time
   

  

 Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self\-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world. NVIDIA Cloud Functions (NVCF) is an open\-source platform that links workloads to GPUs. It lets teams deploy, manage, and serve GPU\-accelerated, containerized applications across regions and clusters worldwide. The platform routes inference, streaming, and batch jobs across decentralized GPU clusters. This allows endpoints to scale repeatably, whether hosted on\-prem or in the cloud.
   

  

 We are seeking a Senior Systems Software Engineer to join our team. You will focus on improving the performance, reliability, and scaling behavior of a system that routes AI workloads onto distributed GPU fleets. You will work on a polyglot platform that is now fully open source, with both control plane and edge deployments. The work suits someone with deep experience in systems performance, distributed systems, and Kubernetes\-based runtimes. We are looking for engineers who want to learn and grow. Expect to be challenged in an environment with rapidly shifting priorities, where insight, focus, and execution are key.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing**
* You'll be working in a distributed team that explores innovative ways to make GPU\- and DPU\-accelerated applications easier to develop, deploy, and monitor on the latest and greatest NVIDIA hardware.
* Design and ship services in Java, Go, and Rust, building in the open on a public repository where your commits, design proposals, and reviews are transparent to the community.
* Work on automating and optimizing build, test, integration, and release processes for cloud native.
* Partner with engineering teams across NVIDIA so the platform integrates with adjacent NVIDIA technologies, including the KAI Scheduler, NVIDIA NIM, Grove, and Dynamo.
* Help steward an open\-source project. You will triage community issues and pull requests and write docs contributors can build on.


**What We Need To See**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience
* 3\+ years of hands\-on software engineering.
* Expert\-level knowledge in a systems programming language (Go, C, Rust) and a proven understanding of Data Structures, Algorithms, and Distributed Software Architecture
* Strong understanding of container orchestration systems (Kubernetes) and container technologies with hands\-on automation experience in continuous integration frameworks like GitLab \& ArgoCD.
* Expertise in a scripting language (Bash, Python) and knowledge and experience working with the system internals of Unix/Unix\-like kernels such as Linux.
* Understanding of performance, security, and reliability in complex distributed systems.


**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**
* Background with pub\-sub models and message queues
* Experience optimizing for high\-throughput network paths, with a working understanding of unary versus streaming and bidirectional protocols across HTTP/2 and gRPC.
* Experience with developing Kubernetes Custom Resources and Operators deployed in Cloud Service Providers


 With competitive salaries and a generous benefits package, NVIDIA is considered one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward\-thinking and hardworking individuals in the industry working for us. Due to unprecedented growth, our exclusive engineering teams are expanding rapidly. If you're a creative and autonomous engineer with a genuine passion for technology, we want to hear from you!
