title: Lead Fenergo KYC SaaS Developer / Configuration Engineer
description:
**Role Purpose**
 The Lead Fenergo KYC SaaS Developer / Configuration Engineer will play a central role in the implementation, development and ongoing management of LSEG’s Fenergo KYC SaaS platform. During the initial Day 0 and MVP implementation, the role will work closely with Fenergo, systems integrators and other third\-party delivery partners to shape the solution, validate designs, oversee configuration and integrations, and ensure that the platform is implemented in a maintainable and supportable manner. Following the initial implementation, the role will transition into a long\-term platform ownership position, responsible for the ongoing development, delivery, operation and technical management of Fenergo within an Agile, product\-led environment. This is a hands\-on engineering and configuration role. The successful candidate will combine deep knowledge of the Fenergo platform with strong delivery, integration and product\-development capabilities. They will act as an internal subject\-matter expert, reduce dependency on third parties and help establish a sustainable in\-house Fenergo engineering capability.
   

  

**Requirements**
 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Day 0 and MVP Implementation
   

  

* Work alongside Fenergo, systems integrators and implementation partners to deliver the initial KYC platform capability.
* Review and challenge solution designs, requirements, configuration approaches and integration patterns proposed by third parties.
* Ensure that business and AFC policy requirements are translated accurately into Fenergo workflows, rules, risk models and data requirements.
* Validate that proposed solutions use standard Fenergo capabilities appropriately and avoid unnecessary customisation.
* Participate directly in platform configuration, integration development, testing, data migration and deployment activities.
* Identify design defects, product limitations, operational risks and maintainability concerns early in the delivery lifecycle.
* Ensure that technical decisions, configuration and integration patterns are appropriately documented.
* Establish effective knowledge transfer from implementation partners into LSEG.
* Build sufficient internal capability to support a controlled transition from vendor\-led implementation to internal platform ownership.
* Support readiness for production, including operational acceptance, support models, monitoring, release processes and environment controls.


 Platform Configuration and Development
   

  

* Configure and maintain Fenergo KYC and Client Lifecycle Management capabilities.
* Develop workflows covering onboarding, due diligence, periodic reviews, event\-driven reviews, remediation and offboarding.
* Configure lifecycle stages, activities, tasks, queues, approvals, routing logic, service levels and exception\-handling processes.
* Configure entity types, related parties, ownership and control structures, beneficial ownership requirements, documents and declarations.
* Develop and maintain customer risk\-assessment models, due\-diligence rules and risk\-based processing.
* Configure user roles, permissions, work groups and segregation\-of\-duties controls.
* Assess new requirements against existing platform capabilities and recommend appropriate implementation options.
* Promote reusable configuration patterns and consistent engineering standards across the platform.
* Maintain the platform in a manner that minimises technical debt and supports future scalability.


 Policy and Rules Management
   

  

* Translate KYC, AML and wider AFC policies into executable Fenergo configuration and decision logic.
* Configure policy rules based on jurisdiction, legal\-entity type, product, customer relationship, risk, ownership and other relevant attributes.
* Implement simplified, standard and enhanced due\-diligence requirements.
* Configure policy applicability, data requirements, evidence requirements, documentation and approval thresholds.
* Maintain customer risk\-rating methodologies and associated decision rules.
* Perform impact assessments for changes to AFC policy, regulation or business processes.
* Maintain traceability between policy requirements, business rules, platform configuration and test evidence.
* Ensure policy changes are implemented through controlled product and release\-management processes.


 Integration Development
   

  

* Design, develop and support integrations between Fenergo and the broader LSEG technology estate.
* Implement integrations using supported Fenergo APIs, events, webhooks, connectors, batch interfaces and internal integration mechanisms.
* Integrate Fenergo with party\-master platforms, screening services, identity\-verification providers, document repositories, product platforms, data services and reporting solutions.
* Define and maintain interface contracts, field mappings, validation rules, transformations and reconciliation controls.
* Implement appropriate integration monitoring, error handling, retry and recovery processes.
* Diagnose issues across Fenergo, middleware, data and downstream\-system boundaries.
* Work with architecture and engineering teams to ensure integrations align with LSEG security, data and technology standards.
* Manage the impact of changes to upstream and downstream systems on Fenergo processes.


 Product\-Led Platform Ownership
   

  

* Take long\-term ownership of Fenergo as a strategic KYC platform and technology product.
* Work closely with the Product Owner to define and maintain the platform roadmap and product backlog.
* Translate business outcomes, policy changes, operational improvements and technical requirements into deliverable backlog items.
* Contribute technical expertise during product discovery, prioritisation and roadmap planning.
* Balance new capability delivery with platform resilience, simplification, maintenance and technical\-debt reduction.
* Provide clear advice on platform capabilities, constraints, costs and design trade\-offs.
* Identify opportunities to improve automation, user experience, control effectiveness and operational efficiency.
* Track platform performance, adoption, service quality and delivery outcomes.
* Support incremental development of the platform beyond the initial MVP.
* Ensure the platform evolves in line with changing business, regulatory and technology requirements.


 Agile Delivery
   

  

* Operate as a senior member of a cross\-functional Agile product team.
* Participate in discovery, backlog refinement, sprint planning, daily stand\-ups, reviews and retrospectives.
* Break down requirements into clear technical and configuration deliverables.
* Provide estimates and identify dependencies, delivery risks and technical constraints.
* Deliver configuration, integrations and platform enhancements through iterative releases.
* Work closely with Product, AFC Operations, Compliance, Architecture, Engineering, Testing and Service Management.
* Support automated and repeatable testing, deployment and configuration\-validation practices.
* Ensure that each release meets agreed functional, non\-functional, security and operational requirements.
* Promote continuous improvement across engineering and product\-delivery practices.


 Environment, Release and Configuration Management
   

  

* Manage Fenergo environments across development, testing, pre\-production and production.
* Establish controlled processes for configuration promotion and deployment between environments.
* Maintain environment\-specific settings, endpoints, reference data and integration dependencies.
* Support release planning, implementation, verification and rollback activities.
* Identify and resolve configuration drift and unintended differences between environments.
* Coordinate SaaS upgrades, patches, maintenance windows and vendor releases.
* Assess vendor release notes and identify impacts on existing configuration, integrations and operating processes.
* Ensure appropriate regression testing is completed for platform upgrades and changes.
* Maintain accurate configuration inventories, release records and audit evidence.
* Ensure platform changes comply with LSEG change, security and operational\-risk controls.


 Platform Operations and Service Management
   

  

* Own the technical health and operational stability of the Fenergo platform.
* Provide technical support for production processes and business\-critical KYC journeys.
* Investigate incidents involving workflows, rules, integrations, data, access or platform configuration.

title: Software Engineer-Kernel/Driver
description:
**Company Description**
**Arista Networks** 
 is an industry leader in data\-driven, client\-to\-cloud networking for large data center, campus and routing environments. Arista is a well\-established and profitable company with over $8 billion in revenue. Arista’s award\-winning platforms, ranging in Ethernet speeds up to 800G bits per second, redefine scalability, agility, and resilience. Arista is a founding member of the Ultra Ethernet consortium. We have shipped over 20 million cloud networking ports worldwide with CloudVision and EOS, an advanced network operating system. Arista is committed to open standards, and its products are available worldwide directly and through partners.
   

  

 At Arista, we value the diversity of thought and perspectives each employee brings. We believe fostering an inclusive environment where individuals from various backgrounds and experiences feel welcome is essential for driving creativity and innovation.
   

  

 Our commitment to excellence has earned us several prestigious awards, such as the Great Place to Work Survey for Best Engineering Team and Best Company for Diversity, Compensation, and Work\-Life Balance. At Arista, we take pride in our track record of success and strive to maintain the highest quality and performance standards in everything we do.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Who You'll Work With**
 Arista Networks is looking for world\-class Senior/Lead Network Systems software engineers.
   

  

 Network systems software is all about managing hardware components on switches and routers. As a senior/lead Network Systems engineer, you will collaborate and work with customers, product management and hardware engineers to design and build novel features that help Arista hardware run effectively and efficiently. You will write software that controls everything from temperature sensors, fan controllers, power controllers, storage devices to FPGAs, NICs and PCIE switches. You will design abstractions that allow this software to be easily packaged and integrated into hardware drivers that manage all our hardware. You will have the opportunity to design solutions to accelerate key functions using hardware and FPGAs to improve system performance. You will also get to work closely with our hardware engineers throughout the lifecycle of our products \- ranging from influencing hardware designs for ease of software control, to bringing up brand new hardware and taking it through the development cycle to market
   

  

**What You'll Do**
 Arista Software Engineering roles demand a strong and broad software engineering background. While the primary focus area for this role is Network Systems software, the role will cover all aspects of software development spanning the addition of new features, debugging problems and fine tuning code for scalability and performance. You will own your projects from definition to deployment and customer interactions, and you will be responsible for the quality of everything you deliver.
   

  

 Arista Software Engineering prides itself on a supportive and growth oriented culture. Over time, as your interests change, coupled with evolving business needs you will have the opportunity to switch from packet forwarding to other areas, if you like.
   

  

* Interface with customers, product management and hardware engineers to come up with innovative new network systems features.
* Architect, design and manage the development of these features.
* Develop and maintain features using C, C\+\+ and Python, review and contribute to functional and design specifications. Build automated tests and test infrastructure to test the features.
* Work with hardware and manufacturing teams to bring new hardware to market.
* Collaborate with hardware engineers to design optimal software control interfaces for managing hardware components.
* Provide technical leadership across features, projects and tools.
* Work with Customer Support Engineers and customers to analyze, mitigate and fix problems in customer networks.
* Work with the System Test Engineers to analyze problems found in their tests and provide fixes for those problems.
* Mentor new and junior engineers to bring them up to speed in Arista's software development environment


**Qualifications**
* BS/ MS Computer Science/Electrical Engineering/Computer Engineering \+ 4 years experience
* Expert knowledge of C or C\+\+ and Python.
* Knowledge of UNIX or Linux
* Hands\-on experience in the design and development of hardware device drivers and/or system management utilities
* Understanding of IP networking and/or distributed systems is a plus
* Experience working with low level hardware components is a plus
* Applied understanding of software engineering principles
* Strong problem solving and software troubleshooting skills
* Ability to design a solution and implement features independently.
* Ability to work in small teams


**Additional Information**
 Arista stands out as an engineering\-centric company. Our leadership, including founders and engineering managers, are all engineers who understand sound software engineering principles and the importance of doing things right.
   

  

 We hire globally into our diverse team. At Arista, engineers have complete ownership of their projects. Our management structure is flat and streamlined, and software engineering is led by those who understand it best. We prioritize the development and utilization of test automation tools.
   

  

 Our engineers have access to every part of the company, providing opportunities to work across various domains. Arista is headquartered in Santa Clara, California, with development offices in Australia, Canada, India, Ireland, and the US. We consider all our R\&D centers equal in stature.
   

  

 Join us to shape the future of networking and be part of a culture that values invention, quality, respect, and fun.

**What We Offer**

You may be just the right person for this or other roles.*

title: Staff Software Engineer-dbt core
description:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data\-driven.
   

  

**About Us**
 Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry\-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.
   

  

 Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.
   

  

 Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.
   

  

 As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.
   

  

 During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Our mission is to empower data practitioners to create and disseminate organizational knowledge. dbt Core is the open\-source engine at the heart of this mission, used by tens of thousands of analysts and engineers to transform data with the rigor of software engineering. We are looking for a systems\-oriented engineer to join the small, expert team that builds and maintains this foundational piece of the modern data stack. This is an opportunity to work on deeply technical, high\-leverage problems where your contributions will improve the daily workflow of a massive and passionate open\-source community.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The dbt Core team are the stewards of the open\-source engine that powers the modern data stack for tens of thousands of practitioners. This small, high\-trust group of systems engineers tackles the most fundamental challenges in dbt: ensuring the performance, reliability, and architectural integrity of
 *dbt* 
 itself. They not only own the core execution engine but also architect the crucial adapter framework that connects dbt to a growing ecosystem of databases and data platforms.
   

  

 As a Staff Software Engineer on the Core \& Adapters team, you will be a steward of the performance, reliability, and architectural integrity of dbt. You will tackle ambiguous, open\-ended problems and take ownership of critical systems.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Dive deep into the dbt\-core execution engine, using your systems expertise to identify, debug, and eliminate performance bottlenecks in our Python codebase.
* Architect and implement improvements to our adapter interface, the crucial layer that connects dbt to a growing ecosystem of databases and data platforms, enabling the community to build more powerful and efficient integrations.
* Debug complex, system\-level issues that span from Linux process management and concurrency models to database query planning and network protocols.
* Lead technical design discussions and contribute to the long\-term architectural roadmap for dbt Core, making key decisions about what, how, and when we build to ensure its scalability and reliability for years to come.
* Mentor other engineers and review contributions from our vibrant open\-source community, upholding our high standards for code quality, testing, and design while fostering a collaborative and inclusive environment.
* Take strong ownership of our distributed systems, troubleshoot complex production issues, and participate in an on\-call rotation to maintain high availability and deliver a resilient platform experience.


**Skills We’re Looking For**
 We are looking for an engineer with a strong performance and debugging mindset, excellent mental models for complex systems, and a deep curiosity for infrastructure and open\-source software.
   

  

 Required Qualifications:
   

  

* 6\+ years of professional software development experience, with a focus on building and operating backend systems in a production environment.
* Deep backend engineering experience and proficiency in Python.
* A systematic, first\-principles approach to problem\-solving, with comfort navigating and debugging in Linux environments (e.g., understanding process scheduling, memory management, file systems).
* Solid grasp of database internals, such as query execution engines, storage layers, indexing strategies, and transaction management.
* Excellent communication skills and a sense of ownership, with the ability to balance technical depth with fast, iterative delivery.


 Preferred Qualifications:
   

  

* A background in data warehousing, data engineering, or analytics engineering.
* Professional experience writing production code in Go or Rust.
* Experience contributing to or maintaining a popular open\-source project.
* Experience building compilers, interpreters, or developer tooling.
* Familiarity with performance analysis tools like perf or strace.


 The Team \& Our Culture
   

  

 You will join a small, high\-trust team of senior and staff\-level engineers who are passionate about building robust, well\-crafted, and reliable software. We operate in a remote\-first, asynchronous\-friendly environment that values deep work, clear written communication, and a high degree of autonomy. We are deeply connected to our users and the open\-source community, and we believe that the best solutions come from a rigorous, collaborative, and empathetic engineering process.
   

  

**Perks And Benefits**
 100% employer\-paid medical insurance
 - Generous paid time\-off policy (PTO), plus paid sick time, inclusive parental leave policy, holidays (including a year end Global Week of Rest), and volunteer days off

 We’re honored to be valued at over $5\.6 billion, but more importantly, we’re proud of our core values of Get Stuck In, Do the Right Thing, and One Team, One Dream. Read about us in Forbes.
   

  

 Fivetran brings together high\-quality talent across the globe to make data access as easy and reliable as electricity for our customers. title: Staff Platform Engineer — Infra & Common Layer — Swym
description:
**Job Description**
 About the job Remote\-first
   

  

* Full\-time
* Bengaluru\-based team. Sits within Platform Engineering, working closely with swym\-integration, SRE, and the AI/automation function. What Swym is and why this role exists Every day, millions of shoppers save products they want but are not ready to buy. Most brands never know it happened. Swym fixes that. We capture what shoppers want at the earliest and most specific point in their journey, and we make that signal usable across every channel a brand has, until the purchase completes. 48,000\+ brands use Swym today. Building the feature is rarely the hard part anymore. With AI doing first\-draft engineering, most features move from idea to working prototype fast. What doesn't move on its own is adoption: whether a merchant who has access to a capability actually turns it on, uses it, and keeps using it. That gap, between shipped and adopted, is what this role exists to close. Every restock or price\-drop event on a merchant's store fans out to thousands of alerts—email, SMS, push—across Wishlist Plus, Back in Stock, and Price Drop. As our footprint has scaled to tens of thousands of Shopify merchants, our high\-fan\-out pipelines—originally built on Redis—are reaching the limits of their original architecture. To support our next phase of enterprise growth, we are modernizing this foundation: introducing strict multi\-tenant isolation, guaranteed message SLAs, and high\-signal, actionable observability that eliminates operational noise. Building a new queue architecture is straightforward. The real engineering craft lies in executing a zero\-downtime migration of a live, high\-throughput system without merchant disruption, while establishing the SLA discipline and observability that makes the next five years of this pipeline predictable and resilient. Moving our infrastructure from "handles current volume" to "provably reliable per message, per merchant" is what this role exists to achieve. How we actually work We are a lean team that runs on AI and GitHub. No wiki. If it matters, it is in the repo or it does not exist. When a merchant workflow needs instrumenting, AI drafts the event schema. When a channel needs a first\-pass message, AI writes it. When we need to know which merchants are underusing a feature, AI pulls the query. Humans decide what the data actually means, which channel earns the spend or the send, and what gets shipped to a merchant's inbox or in\-app surface. That model runs across this role specifically: positioning is not this role's job, activation is. What you will own In your first 90 days — Master the pipeline and map the architecture Get fluent in the swym\-integration layer end\-to\-end: how a webhook becomes an alert, where Redis operates in that path, and where structural bottlenecks occur under peak load. Identify the highest\-impact queue to migrate first and defend that strategy with real traffic data. Ship the first feature\-toggled queue migration off Redis—live in production, with a thoroughly tested, zero\-risk rollback path. At six months — Scalable event architecture in motion At least 5 core queues are live on the new pipeline behind feature toggles, with automated DLQ and replay mechanisms fully active in production. Achieve rock\-solid queue stability across migrated pathways, maintaining 99\.99%\+ uptime even during high\-volume peak sale events. Ship OpenTelemetry tracing from enqueue to completion for migrated paths, backed by per\-merchant SLA dashboards that flag potential bottlenecks before they impact delivery. At twelve months — Enterprise\-grade reliability and legibility Queue migration off Redis is complete or strictly scoped to deliberate edge\-case workloads. A structured P1–P4 severity framework is live, complete with clear ownership and actionable runbooks that allow engineers across the organization to act with total confidence. Telemetry and trace data are exposed as queryable interfaces for both engineers and LLM agents. Implement service\-to\-service SLAs, noisy\-neighbor isolation, and dedicated priority lanes for enterprise merchants. The success metric at twelve months isn't just migrated queues—it's an operating environment so resilient and legible that on\-call duty becomes completely calm. Who you are Proven Migration Experience: You have deep distributed systems experience and have led at least one zero\-downtime architecture migration at real production scale. You know how to safely evolve live systems without dropping events or interrupting service. SLA \& System Reliability Mindset: You think in failure modes, multi\-tenant isolation, and explicit performance guarantees. When reviewing observability, your goal is high signal\-to\-noise ratio and immediate actionability. AI\-First Workflow: You leverage AI to draft instrumentation, scaffold migration tools, and query traces—while keeping critical judgment on cutover risks, system boundaries, and architecture squarely in your hands. Background: 7\+ years in Platform, SRE, or Distributed Infrastructure roles (as a guideline). Clojure experience and familiarity with high\-fan\-out notification systems are a strong plus, but engineering judgment and migration experience matter most. What is in it for you Most infrastructure modernizations are scoped as background "maintenance" bolted onto someone's existing workload without the authority to change core architecture. Here, you own the entire path: from evolving legacy queueing patterns to establishing the SLA and telemetry standards for our core messaging engine. If your idea of a great career win is: "I took a foundational high\-throughput system, modernized it live without dropping a single merchant event, and turned a complex pipeline into a bulletproof enterprise platform," you'll thrive here. Logistics Compensation: Competitive cash and meaningful equity. We will talk specifics early. How to apply Please apply directly through this LinkedIn job post or send your resume across to rishin.babu@swymcorp.com or sakshi.gupta@swymcorp.com

title: SDE II, EE Experiences, Everyday Essentials Experiences
description:
**Description**
 Everyday Essentials (EE) is a $100B\+ business and one of the fastest\-growing categories at Amazon — the household staples, health and personal care, grocery, and beauty products hundreds of millions of customers reorder. We're reinventing how customers discover, buy, and get more value from them, and we're looking for Software Development Engineers who want to build that future.
   

  

 The EE Experiences organization builds the shopping experience for the products customers come back for most. Our charter is Progressive Discovery and Monetization: helping customers find better products for their needs, complete their baskets, and get more value on every essentials purchase — and giving the world's largest consumer brands new and effective ways to reach those customers and grow with Amazon. We build a durable, profitable business at the intersection of the two, on the surfaces customers use every day.
   

  

 This is a space where the hardest problems don't have off\-the\-shelf answers. We're not polishing a solved product — we're inventing experiences that don't exist yet, and the decisions we make now shape a business with room to grow for years. You'll have the freedom to propose new ideas, prototype them, and ship them worldwide. Your work moves from whiteboard to production in front of a very large customer base, with visibility all the way to senior leadership.
   

  

 We're an AI\-first team, and that shows up in two ways. We use AI throughout how we build software, and we expect our engineers to keep learning and applying the latest tools to move faster and raise the quality bar. AI is also at the core of what we build — the intelligence that helps customers find the right product is a modeling and engineering problem we work on hand in hand with scientists. If you're curious about AI, learn quickly, and like using it to solve real customer problems while keeping a clear head about where it helps and where it doesn't, you'll fit right in.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Design, build, and own software end to end — working backwards from the customer through design, code, testing, deployment, and operations.
* Take on ambiguous problems where the goal is clear but the path is not, bring clarity, and deliver simple solutions to hard problems.
* Partner closely with scientists, product managers, and designers to turn customer problems into products that ship worldwide.
* Use AI tools and modern engineering practices to build faster and at a higher bar of quality, and help the team level up how it uses them.
* Own operational excellence for what you build — monitor it, respond when issues arise, and keep improving the customer and partner experience.
* Raise the technical bar through code reviews, mentoring, and hiring for the best talent.


 A day in the life
   

  

 Most days start with the customer problem in front of you: how to help someone find a better everyday\-essentials product, or fill their basket faster. You dig into data, sketch a design, and talk it through with product managers and scientists before writing any code. By the afternoon you might be prototyping an idea that didn't exist yesterday, reviewing a teammate's change, or debugging something in production. Because so much here is new, you won't just pick up tickets. You'll help decide what to build, push for the approach you believe in, and see your work reach customers in weeks, not quarters.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Our team owns how customers discover and buy the everyday essentials they rely on — and how the brands behind those products reach them. Our mission is to make restocking the things you need effortless, and to help customers find better options along the way. Day to day you'll work with fellow engineers and partner closely with product managers, designers, and scientists, who bring the customer and data insight that shapes what we build. We're a small, fast\-moving group solving open\-ended problems for hundreds of millions of shoppers — a place where you own problems end to end and your ideas reach customers fast.

* 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience
* 2\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent


**Preferred Qualifications**

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer with strong infrastructure expertise to design, build, and operate the next generation of our enterprise Observability, Automation, and AI\-driven Reliability Platform.
   

  

 This role will build highly scalable distributed systems and platform services spanning Storage, Compute, Network, VMware, OpenShift, and bare\-metal infrastructure. The engineer will help transform infrastructure operations from reactive monitoring and manual remediation to proactive, predictive, and AI\-driven autonomous operations.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing**
* Design, build, and operate distributed software platforms for enterprise observability, telemetry, automation, and infrastructure reliability at large scale.
* Develop reusable platform services, APIs, automation frameworks, and control planes that enable self\-service, reduce operational toil, and automate infrastructure operations across multiple engineering teams.
* Build scalable telemetry and event\-processing systems spanning metrics, logs, traces, events, topology, and alerts, with the performance and efficiency to process billions of infrastructure signals.
* Build intelligent and AI\-native reliability capabilities, including agentic workflows for anomaly detection, forecasting, root\-cause analysis, automated debugging, and closed\-loop remediation.
* Drive technical architecture and engineering direction across Storage, Compute, Network, and Platform domains, solving complex and ambiguous problems that span multiple teams.
* Engineer for production at scale, with strong focus on software quality, scalability, security, performance, observability, maintainability, and operational readiness.
* Provide technical leadership and mentorship, influence engineering standards and architecture decisions, and deliver measurable improvements in reliability, MTTR, operational toil, engineering productivity, and infrastructure efficiency.


**What We Need To See**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience, with 10\+ years of software engineering, SRE, infrastructure, or distributed\-systems experience and demonstrated technical leadership.
* Strong software engineering expertise in Go, Python, or equivalent languages, with experience designing and building production\-grade distributed systems, platform services, APIs, and automation.
* Proven experience owning complex software/platform initiatives across multiple teams or infrastructure domains, from architecture and implementation through adoption and measurable impact.
* Deep understanding of distributed systems, event\-driven architectures, microservices, APIs, and high\-throughput data processing, including technologies such as Kafka, NATS, gRPC, or equivalent.
* Strong experience with modern observability and telemetry platforms, including OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, VictoriaMetrics, Vector, Loki, Grafana, ClickHouse, or equivalent technologies.
* Strong SRE and infrastructure knowledge across Kubernetes/OpenShift, VMware, bare\-metal, storage, networking, and/or cloud environments, with experience using Terraform, Ansible, or equivalent automation technologies.
* Demonstrated ability to solve ambiguous problems, influence technical direction without direct authority, mentor engineers, establish engineering standards, and deliver measurable operational and business outcomes.


**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**
* Experience building software and reliability platforms for large\-scale on\-premises infrastructure, particularly Storage, Compute, Networking, VMware, and Kubernetes/OpenShift.
* Deep understanding of storage and infrastructure telemetry, including IOPS, latency, NVMe health, SAN/NAS topology, block/object storage, and infrastructure failure domains.
* Experience building self\-healing systems, automated remediation, predictive operations, or autonomous SRE capabilities.
* Production experience applying Generative AI, AIOps, LLMs, or Agentic AI to incident triage, RCA, operational intelligence, debugging, or remediation; experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, or equivalent is a plus.
* Experience building high\-performance platform services using FastAPI, gRPC, or equivalent technologies.

**Job Description**
**About the Role**
 We are seeking an experienced Senior Software Engineer to join our Industrial AI Platform Engineering team. This role will be instrumental in advancing the IRIS Foundry Flows platform, enabling industrial enterprises to build, deploy, and scale AI\-powered workflows across diverse environments including AWS, GCP, Azure, and on\-premises deployments.
   

  

 As part of the core platform engineering team, you will design and develop highly scalable backend services, enhance platform reliability, drive cloud\-agnostic architecture initiatives, and contribute to next\-generation workflow orchestration capabilities that support global industrial customers and strategic accounts.
   

  

 This role offers the opportunity to shape critical platform capabilities that serve as the foundation for Industrial AI solutions across manufacturing, process industries, and enterprise operations.

 Backend Platform Development
   

  

 Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services powering the IRIS Foundry Flows platform.
   

  

 Build robust APIs, microservices, and distributed systems to support workflow orchestration and data processing.
   

  

 Develop reusable platform components that accelerate feature delivery across multiple product teams.
   

  

 Cloud \& Deployment Engineering

 Design cloud\-agnostic architectures that support diverse customer infrastructure requirements.
   

  

 Improve platform portability, deployment automation, and operational efficiency.
   

  

 Scalability \& Reliability
   

  

 Drive improvements in platform stability, performance, and fault tolerance.
   

  

 Optimize high\-volume transaction processing and workflow execution.
   

  

 Implement monitoring, observability, and resiliency best practices.
   

  

 Architecture \& Innovation
   

  

 Contribute to technical architecture decisions and long\-term platform roadmap.
   

  

 Participate in system design discussions for large\-scale distributed applications.
   

  

 Identify opportunities to enhance platform capabilities through innovative engineering solutions.
   

  

 Cross\-Functional Collaboration
   

  

 Partner with Product Management, AI Engineering, Cloud Operations, and Customer Success teams.
   

  

 Support strategic customer deployments and complex integration requirements.
   

  

 Mentor engineers and promote engineering best practices within the team.
   

  

  

  

**Required Qualifications**
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
   

  

 6\+ years of hands\-on software development experience.
   

  

 Strong proficiency in Java and/or Python.
   

  

 Experience building and supporting backend distributed systems and microservices architectures.
   

  

 Strong understanding of REST APIs, asynchronous processing, and event\-driven architectures.
   

  

 Experience with AWS cloud services and cloud\-native application development.
   

  

 Solid understanding of software design principles, data structures, algorithms, and system design.
   

  

 Experience with containerization and deployment technologies.
   

  

 Strong debugging, performance tuning, and problem\-solving skills.
   

  

  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
 Experience designing multi\-cloud or cloud\-portable platforms.
   

  

 Experience supporting enterprise SaaS or platform products.
   

  

 Exposure to workflow orchestration platforms and automation frameworks.
   

  

 Familiarity with Kubernetes, Docker, and Infrastructure as Code.
   

  

 Knowledge of Generative AI, Conversational AI, or AI platform development.
   

  

 Experience with observability, monitoring, and platform reliability engineering.
   

  

 Prior experience working in large\-scale technology organizations.
   

  

 Prior experience with enterprise\-grade agentic AI platform development.
   

  

  

  

**Success in This Role**
 In this role, you will:
   

  

 Accelerate delivery of new Flows platform capabilities.
   

  

 Improve platform robustness, scalability, and operational excellence.
   

  

 Enable deployment adaptability for industrial customers with varied infrastructure requirements.
   

  

 Contribute to the evolution of the broader IRIS Foundry platform strategy.
   

  

 Play a key role in supporting the growth of SymphonyAI's Industrial AI solutions globally.

title: Senior Software Engineer, International Expansion
description:
**About Handshake**
 Handshake was founded on a simple belief that everyone deserves a path to a great career, regardless of where they went to school or who they know. Today, we power 25 million job seekers, 1 million\+ employers, and 1,600 educational institutions.
   

  

 In 2025, we started Handshake AI and built the fastest\-growing AI data business in history. We work directly with frontier AI lab researchers to create evaluations, publish benchmarks, and push the boundary of data. We’ve grown from $0 to \~$1B run rate and pay \~$60M to over 30K individuals every month.
   

  

**Why Join Handshake Now**
* Shape how every career evolves in the AI economy, at global scale, with impact your friends, family and peers can see and feel
* Partner hand\-in\-hand with world\-class AI labs, Fortune 500 partners and the world’s top educational institutions
* Work together with engineers, scientists, operators, and more from Palantir, Meta, Scale AI, and former YC founders
* Build a massive, fast\-growing business with billions in revenue


**About Handshake AI**
 Human data is the core infrastructure to AI advancement. Frontier AI labs currently improve model capabilities with various data\-intensive post\-training techniques. We believe that data spend for AI training will increase by 3\-5x in the next few years and continue for much longer as models take on new domains. Handshake AI supports all of the frontier AI labs, working on their most complex data at the largest scale.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a Senior Software Engineer on this team, you'll own the full stack of impact \- from the experiences our fellows rely on every day to the internal tools and platform capabilities that let our operators run the business with speed and quality. This role sits at the intersection of product engineering, platform infrastructure, and operations, functioning much like an embedded engineering group: you'll partner directly with Growth, Product, Operations, and ML to deeply understand both fellow\-facing and operator workflows, and translate them into reliable, scalable systems.
   

  

 As AI continues to reshape how people learn, work, and build careers, you'll help define the consumer experience that sets our fellows up for success, while also building the internal tooling and technical foundations that let operators \- and the business as a whole move just as fast. Whether you're shipping customer\-facing features, architecting internal automation, or modernizing core infrastructure, your work will have a direct and lasting impact on our users, our operators, and our ability to innovate at scale.
   

  

 This is a highly collaborative, communication\-heavy role. Success requires strong technical fundamentals, systems thinking, and high EQ — the ability to translate ambiguous or urgent needs (from fellows, operators, or the business) into clear technical solutions, along with the judgment to balance rapid execution with thoughtful, long\-term engineering decisions. We're looking for engineers who are excited to take ownership of meaningful problems, influence technical direction, and shape not just what we build, but how we build it.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Build and own core experiences across the fellow platform, including onboarding, the fellow homepage, and project opportunities, while designing systems that power fellow allocation and evolve manual operational workflows into scalable platform capabilities.
* Embed with operators to understand their processes, pain points, and success metrics, and architect internal tools, automations, and workflows that improve operational throughput, accuracy, and visibility.
* Partner closely with Growth, Operations, Product, and ML to understand business processes and translate them into high\-quality technical solutions.
* Lead projects end\-to\-end \- from discovery, scoping, and technical design through implementation, rollout, and continuous iteration.
* Drive architectural improvements that reduce technical debt and establish scalable service layers as the platform grows.
* Balance speed and quality by making thoughtful engineering tradeoffs that support both immediate business needs and long\-term maintainability.
* Collaborate across teams to build reliable, secure systems that improve both the fellow and operator experience, and to drive adoption and measurable impact.
* Mentor other engineers through technical leadership, project ownership, and strong engineering practices \- including in a "player\-coach" capacity as the team grows.


**Desired Capabilities**
* 6\+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a track record of owning production systems end\-to\-end, from requirements through production support.
* Experience leading technical projects involving multiple contributors, including coordinating work and driving successful execution.
* Strong proactive communication and stakeholder management skills, with high empathy/EQ and the ability to partner deeply with non\-engineering teams and translate ambiguous or urgent needs into effective technical solutions.
* Excellent engineering judgment and systems thinking \- able to design scalable architectures, pick the right level of abstraction, and make pragmatic tradeoffs without over\-building.
* Experience improving or modernizing existing systems, balancing rapid product development with long\-term platform health.
* Experience building internal tools, workflow systems, or automation for operations\-heavy teams (or analogous customer\-embedded roles like FDE/solutions engineering).
* Comfortable operating in fast\-moving, ambiguous environments where priorities evolve quickly.
* Passion for building products and tools that directly impact customer and operator experience at scale.


**Extra Credit**
* Experience building marketplace, allocation, matching, or workflow systems.
* Experience with AI workflows and agentic infrastructure.
* Experience designing service\-oriented architectures or platform infrastructure that enables future product growth.
* Experience with workflow/backlog systems, intake processes, and operational analytics (instrumentation, dashboards, QA).
* Background building tooling for knowledge\-work operations (e.g., case management, review/approval flows, data quality tooling).
* Excited to apply expertise in complex, at\-scale systems to an AI\-driven, rapidly evolving product landscape.


**You’ll Thrive Here If You**
* Are motivated by solving operational problems that have direct, measurable impact.
* Want to be part of a company shaping the future of AI through human data.
* Can navigate ambiguity, act with urgency, and keep multiple workstreams moving in parallel.


**Perks**
* Generous Equity Grant vested over 4 years
* Housing Bonus: 1\.3 Lakhs spread throughout the first year
* Well Defined Performance Bonus ranging between 10 \- 100% of base
* Medical Insurance Coverage
* Food credit for every in person day.

* We are looking for an experienced Storage Software Engineer with 12\-15 years of software engineering experience to design, architect, and build highly scalable Block, File, and Object Storage platforms in Kubernetes environments.

You will be responsible for building production\-grade storage software with a strong focus on performance, scalability, reliability, availability, and data durability.

**Responsibilities**

****What You’ll Do****
* Lead complex engineering initiatives spanning multiple teams, systems, and technical domains.
* Shape technical strategy and help translate long\-term product vision into an executable engineering roadmap.

* Drive technology decisions that result in measurable improvements in reliability, performance, scalability, engineering velocity, and customer experience.

* Bachelor’s or Master degree in Computer Science or Computer Engineering.

* Proficiency in C/C\+\+, Go, or Rust
* Strong understanding of Linux, concurrency, networking, and storage I/O.
* Experience with Kubernetes and cloud\-native architectures.

 The team provides the most scalable and reliable SDN Production Infrastructure for Google.
   

  

 Orion, the Software Defined Networking (SDN) brain that powers Google's data center and wide\-area networks within the broader Network Infrastructure group. The team mission is to deliver a holistic infrastructure to run Orion and improve Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) scalability. This mission is cross\-functional, touching Orion's own design, the systems that are used for management (e.g., config push) as well as the software stacks that Orion relies on (e.g., Chubby, Network Computing System (NCS) machines).  Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Own Orion Hierarchical Rollouts, Orion Config. Provide technical leadership on high\-impact projects.
* Execute on the Orion Rollouts roadmap, aligned to a long\-term Orion SDN goal. Influence and coach a distributed team of engineers.
* Understand the Orion SDN domain space, customer use cases, their current and future needs, help defining components architecture. Facilitate alignment and clarity across teams on goals, outcomes, and timelines.
* Drive innovation and execution of innovative solutions in Orion ProdInfra including Orion Rollouts, Orion Config. Manage project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables.

description:

 If your priority is a
 **big salary, predictable increments, a fancy designation and a comfortable corporate career** 
 , there are plenty of large companies that can offer you that.
 



  





 We want developers who want to become
 **entrepreneurs inside the organisation** 
 .
 



 People who want to build products from zero, launch them, find users, automate distribution, experiment with marketing, break things, fix them, and eventually create products that generate serious value.
 



  





 You should ideally be able to move across:
 



 • Full\-stack product development
 



 • iOS \& Android applications
 



 • APIs, databases and cloud infrastructure
 



 • AI/LLMs and agentic workflows
 



 • AI\-powered automation

 • Growth experiments and marketing automation

 You should be comfortable hearing:

 …and coming back with a working product.

**Build → Launch → Market → Learn → Scale.** 




 If a product works, we want the people who built it to participate in the upside.
 



 Think of this as an opportunity to become a
 **mini\-founder / entrepreneur within Klyra** 
 , with access to technology, ideas, infrastructure and a team that wants to keep launching things into the world.
 



  





 If you're obsessed with building, constantly experimenting with AI, shipping side projects at midnight, and wondering whether you should start your own company someday…
 



**Come talk to us.** 




  





 Maybe instead of someday, you start now!
 



**Klyra Innovations** 




**Bangalore** 




  





 Send us what you've built.
 



 GitHub, apps, experiments, failed startups, weird AI projects \- anything.
 



 We care far more about
 **proof of hustle than your résumé.**

title: Software engineer - AI-Enabled Python Validation
description:
**Company Description**
 SanDisk develops advanced flash and memory technologies that empower people and businesses to store, access, and manage data. Our globally recognized products are built on innovation, performance, reliability, and quality. We foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, continuous improvement, and technological excellence.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Join SanDisk's Storage Validation Engineering team and help deliver high\-quality software solutions for validating next\-generation flash storage products.
   

  

 In this role, you will develop AI\-assisted Python automation solutions, analyze product and protocol requirements, execute validation on storage devices, investigate complex failures, and contribute to release qualification. You will work closely with software, firmware, validation, and release teams across India, Israel, and the United States.
   

  

 This position is ideal for engineers who enjoy Python development, AI\-assisted engineering, system\-level debugging, Linux and Windows environments, and working close to hardware.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Understand product requirements, technical designs, and storage protocol specifications.
* Create comprehensive validation strategies including functional, negative, integration, stress, recovery, and regression scenarios.
* Plan, design, develop, review, and maintain automated validation solutions using Python and AI\-assisted engineering tools.
* Validate storage features, software enhancements, and bug fixes on physical storage devices.
* Execute sanity, functional, integration, performance, and regression test campaigns.
* Analyze logs, reproduce failures, and isolate issues across test frameworks, host software, firmware, operating systems, and device layers.
* Report defects with clear reproduction steps, logs, configurations, and technical findings.
* Verify fixes and provide evidence\-based quality sign\-off.
* Contribute qualified tests to automated sanity and regression suites.
* Collaborate with globally distributed development, validation, and release teams.
* Improve test automation, diagnostics, reliability, and engineering productivity.
* Leverage AI\-assisted engineering tools responsibly for test design, coding, debugging, data analysis, and documentation activities.


**Qualifications**
 Required Qualifications
   

  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Electronics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
* 3 to 5 years of experience in software engineering, validation, system testing, quality assurance, or test automation.
* Strong programming skills in Python with hands\-on experience developing automated test solutions.
* Experience developing, debugging, and maintaining automated test frameworks.
* Good understanding of software testing methodologies, defect lifecycle management, and quality engineering practices.
* Experience working in Linux and Windows environments.
* Working knowledge of Git and GitHub development workflows.
* Familiarity with AI\-assisted development, testing, debugging, or engineering productivity tools.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills.
* Ability to work independently, drive tasks to completion, and take ownership of validation activities.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with SSDs, flash storage, firmware, drivers, embedded systems, or system software.
* Knowledge of storage protocols such as NVMe, SCSI, or ATA.
* Experience with Python test frameworks, log analysis, and data\-driven testing methodologies.
* Familiarity with GitHub, Jira, Agile, Scrum, and Continuous Integration workflows.
* Working knowledge of C or C\+\+.
* Exposure to large\-scale automation environments and test infrastructure development.
* Experience using AI tools to improve software development, testing, or engineering productivity.


 What We Look For
   

  

* Strong problem\-solving and debugging abilities.
* Attention to detail and commitment to product quality.
* Curiosity to understand complex interactions between software, firmware, operating systems, and hardware.
* Ownership mindset from requirement analysis through validation sign\-off.
* Proactive mindset with a high level of accountability.
* Assertive communicator who can clearly and confidently express technical viewpoints while respecting others.
* Ability to challenge assumptions and make data\-driven decisions.
* Continuous learning attitude with interest in automation, AI\-assisted engineering, and emerging technologies.
* Strong collaboration skills across globally distributed teams.
* Confidence to take initiative, drive improvements, and deliver results


**Additional Information**
 Sandisk thrives on the power and potential of diversity. As a global company, we believe the most effective way to embrace the diversity of our customers and communities is to mirror it from within. We believe the fusion of various perspectives results in the best outcomes for our employees, our company, our customers, and the world around us. We are committed to an inclusive environment where every individual can thrive through a sense of belonging, respect and contribution.

In your email, please include a description of the specific accommodation you are requesting as well as the job title and requisition number of the position for which you are applying.

* Drive the adoption of modern AI testing tools to accelerate test strategy generation and maintenance across the teams.
* Design, develop, and maintain testing strategies to ensure the quality and reliability of our products.
* Ensure comprehensive coverage for functional, performance, interoperability, and benchmarking tests.
* Collaborate with cross functional teams, including developers, product managers, and program managers, to ensure that testing is integrated throughout the software development lifecycle.
* Champion continuous improvement initiatives in the test process, tools, and methodologies.
* Explore and integrate Generative AI tools to enhance test case generation and test strategy.
* Stay up to date with new testing tools and test strategies.


**Qualifications**
* BE/B. Tech in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* Minimum 10 Years experience into Android OS testing with Good exposure on Robot Framework and Appium.
* Ability to work in a fast paced, agile environment.
* Strong expertise in Android testing, including knowledge of the Android OS.
* Experience in writing clear, concise, and comprehensive test plans and test cases.
* Experience with end to end solution testing, interoperability testing, benchmarking, and performance related testing.
* Strong understanding of SDLC, Agile, and DevOps methodologies.
* Strong problem solving skills and attention to detail.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to work across business units and align stakeholders on testing strategies.
* Experience with Generative AI tools for test development.
* Candidate must be based out in Bangalore location only.


**Benefits**
 We understand the importance of work\-life balance and wellbeing, which is why we offer flexibility for our teams including: hybrid work, adaptable hours, Summer Flex Fridays, Focus Fridays, and an annual companywide well\-being day to promote revitalization and success.
   

  

**Job Posting Statement**
 To protect candidates from falling victim to online fraudulent activity involving fake job postings and employment offers, please be aware our recruiters will always connect with you via @zebra.com email accounts. Applications are only accepted through our applicant tracking system and only accept personal identifying information through that system. Our Talent Acquisition team will not ask for you to provide personal identifying information via e\-mail or outside of the system. If you are a victim of identity theft contact your local police department.
   

  

**AI Technology Statement**
 Zebra Technologies leverages AI technology to evaluate job applications using objective, job\-relevant criteria. This approach enhances efficiency and promotes fairness in the hiring process. However, every decision regarding interviews and hiring is made by our dedicated team, because we believe people make the best decisions about people. For more on how we use technology in hiring and how we process applicant data, see our Zebra Privacy Policy.

title: Software Engineer (Python/Wireless)
description:
**Meet The Team**
 The Cisco Wireless Feature \& System Engineering team builds end\-to\-end wireless capabilities across access points, controllers, and cloud\-managed platforms. We design features that span device software, control planes, and management systems to deliver seamless, secure, and high\-performance enterprise Wi\-Fi.
   

  

**Your Impact**
 A software engineer specializing in wireless technology at Cisco is responsible for driving the design, implementation, and optimization of wireless solutions for customer projects and accounts. This role requires a deep understanding of current and emerging wireless standards, including Wi\-Fi 8 (IEEE 802\.11bn / Ultra High Reliability), 802\.1X security types, and Layer 2 protocols. The engineer will leverage AI/ML knowledge to uplift test automation, develop new test plans, and build productivity\-enhancing tools, ensuring superior wireless network reliability, latency, performance, and customer outcomes.
   

  

**In This Role**
* Lead technology design, planning, and deployment of wireless solutions, including small to mid\-size or moderately complex systems, ensuring reliability, availability, latency, resilience, and performance targets are met across current\-generation and emerging Wi\-Fi 8 environments.
* Collaborate with customers to plan, design, configure, and validate Cisco wireless technologies, including Wi\-Fi standards through Wi\-Fi 8 (IEEE 802\.11bn), Layer 2 protocols, WLAN technologies, and 802\.1X security types.
* Write new test automation scripts and uplift existing test scripts using Python to enhance wireless technology testing frameworks and improve automation efficiency.
* Utilize AI/ML techniques to uplift test automation frameworks, develop new test plans tailored to wireless and Wi\-Fi 8 reliability requirements, and build tools that improve productivity and streamline testing and deployment processes.
* Assist with integration and implementation of tools, systems, and service assurance related to wireless networks, including continuous monitoring, telemetry analysis, and alerting in test and production environments for latency, packet loss, roaming, interference, and reliability conditions.
* Support presales by translating business requirements into technical wireless solution designs and creating customer collateral, documentation, and knowledge transfer materials.
* Drive customer technology transitions and influence solution architectures and services in wireless networking, including readiness planning for Wi\-Fi 8 and Ultra High Reliability capabilities.
* Comply with company policies and utilize relevant tools to support Professional Services strategies and goals.
* Act as an individual contributor and mentor within the team, providing guidance and support to peers and engineering interns.
* Lead corrective actions, including root cause analysis and process improvements on escaped defects for specific product features.
* Implement automation frameworks and execute test cases and plans for projects with multiple features, including Wi\-Fi 8 functional, interoperability, performance, reliability, and regression validation.
* Report issues and findings with root cause analysis and potential software solutions; advocate for quality improvements and strategic changes.
* Oversee creation and storage of test plans and documentation; translate dashboard metrics into consumable documentation such as release notes, bug reports, and test results.
* Collaborate with other engineering groups to document test cases and apply best practices for document review.
* Develop productive working relationships with peer stakeholders within and across teams.
* Work independently with guidance from leadership to determine the best approach to accomplish work and act as a resource for less experienced colleagues.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Deep domain\-based engineering and configuration knowledge of Cisco wireless technologies, with knowledge of current Wi\-Fi generations and emerging Wi\-Fi 8 (IEEE 802\.11bn) concepts.
* Working knowledge of Wi\-Fi standards, including Ultra High Reliability objectives, deterministic and tail\-latency behavior, packet\-loss reduction, roaming continuity, overlapping\-BSS performance, multi\-AP coordination concepts, coexistence, and backward compatibility.
* Strong expertise in AI/ML applications for test automation and productivity improvements.
* Experience in writing comprehensive test plans and building automation tools for wireless functional, interoperability, roaming, latency, packet\-loss, reliability, and performance validation.
* Strong problem\-solving and troubleshooting skills specific to wireless networks, including interference, congestion, roaming, latency, packet loss, and multi\-AP deployment scenarios.
* Excellent communication and customer engagement abilities.
* Experience in solution design activities.
* Ability to create and deliver technical documentation and training materials.


**Key Technologies**
* Wi\-Fi Standards: Knowledge of Wi\-Fi generations, including Wi\-Fi 6/6E, Wi\-Fi 7, and emerging Wi\-Fi 8 (IEEE 802\.11bn / Ultra High Reliability). Understanding the evolution of these standards and their security, reliability, latency, power\-efficiency, coexistence, and performance objectives is essential.
* Wi\-Fi 8 / IEEE 802\.11bn: Familiarity with the emerging Ultra High Reliability amendment and its focus on WLAN reliability, latency, throughput, roaming continuity, power efficiency, peer\-to\-peer operation, coexistence, and overlapping\-BSS performance.
* Layer 2 Protocols: Familiarity with Layer 2 security policies such as WLAN, Static WEP, WPA/WPA2, WPA3, and especially 802\.1X authentication. Knowledge of encryption types like TKIP, AES, CCMP, and GCMP is important.
* WLAN Technologies: Expertise in Cisco wireless solutions, including configuration of WLAN security, use of Cisco Wireless LAN Controllers, and deployment of secure WLANs with features such as Fast Secure Roaming (802\.11r), AAA integration with RADIUS and Cisco ISE, multi\-AP architectures, and telemetry\-driven assurance. Familiarity with Wi\-Fi 8 goals for improved reliability, latency, roaming resilience, and operation across overlapping BSS environments is desirable.
* 802\.1X Security Types: Deep understanding of 802\.1X authentication mechanisms including EAP types such as PEAP, EAP\-TLS, LEAP, and EAP\-FAST. Knowledge of how 802\.1X integrates with AAA servers (e.g., Cisco ISE) for centralized policy management, and how it supports secure network access and segmentation.
* Python programming for developing and uplifting test automation scripts, enhancing wireless technology testing frameworks and productivity.
* AI/ML Knowledge: Proficiency in applying Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) to improve wireless performance and operational efficiency. The role includes uplifting test automation, generating wireless test plans, building productivity tools, and validating Wi\-Fi 8 reliability objectives.


 Why Cisco?
   

  

 At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
   

  

 Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
   

  

 We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

title: Staff Software Engineer - Developer Productivity
description:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data\-driven.
   

  

**About Us**
 Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry\-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.
   

  

 Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.
   

  

 Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.
   

  

 As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.
   

  

 During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We’re looking for a
 **Staff Software Engineer** 
 to join the Platform Ops team (Platform Engineering) and lead initiatives that enable developer productivity by building and improving developer tooling and environments, and by improving other productivity tools around observability. Our team builds the shared systems and workflows engineers rely on every day—internal developer environments and self\-serve tooling that makes the recommended way to ship changes the easiest way.
   

  

 This is a platform tooling role with a focus is on reusable capabilities and self\-service workflows adopted across teams. You’ll also help develop AI\-based workflows for productivity and efficiency, including automation that improves infrastructure operations (for example, faster triage, automated runbook steps, and better self\-service for common issues). You’ll prioritize the highest\-impact problems by looking at where time is being lost today (slow builds, flaky tests, manual release steps, repetitive operational work) and turning that into concrete projects. You’ll set clear success metrics up front and use them to guide design decisions and rollouts. Expect to partner closely with engineering teams to drive adoption, document changes, and iterate based on feedback. You’ll drive cross\-team work across internal tooling, developer environments, observability, and reliability, focusing on measurable improvements (for example: shorter lead time, fewer incidents, and faster recovery). You’ll add automation and enable developer workflows across all three major cloud environments (AWS, Azure, and GCP).
   

  

 As a staff engineer on the team, you’ll lead medium\-to\-large initiatives end\-to\-end: define the problem with stakeholders, write a design and rollout plan, build and operate the solution in Python/Go, and measure results. You’ll work across Platform Engineering, Release Engineering, Security, and product engineering teams to make improvements that are adopted broadly and remain reliable over time.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Lead end\-to\-end projects that improve developer tooling, environments, and operational workflows (speed, reliability, and safety)
* Design and operate internal tooling/services in Python and/or Go
* Build tooling for our internal developer platform (self\-service workflows, shared patterns, developer\-facing interfaces)
* Add automation and enable developer workflows across all three major cloud environments (AWS, Azure, and GCP)
* Develop AI\-based workflows that improve developer experience and reduce repetitive manual work, including efficiency gains in infrastructure operations
* Improve developer feedback loops through better observability (metrics/logs/traces), making failures easier to diagnose
* Design/build and document “paved paths” and self\-service capabilities so teams can ship without extensive platform expertise
* Improve reliability through automation and observability (metrics/logs/traces), and drive incident follow\-ups to reduce recurrence
* Set technical direction (design docs, tradeoffs, sequencing) and drive delivery across stakeholders
* Mentor engineers through design and code reviews


**Skills We’re Looking For** 
**:**
* Strong experience building and operating production services in Python and/or Go
* Experience with at least one cloud provider (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and core primitives (IAM, networking, compute)
* Experience building developer productivity tooling (CI systems, build tooling, developer portals, workflow automation)
* Track record leading ambiguous, cross\-team technical projects to completion
* Strong communication and engineering judgment


 You'll have an edge if you have
 **:**
* Kubernetes/platform abstractions experience
* Infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform/OpenTofu), including reusable modules, safe state practices, and modernization of shared platform foundations
* Experience building internal developer platforms (IDPs) / developer portals / self\-service tooling

Fivetran promotes diversity, equity, inclusion \& belonging through attracting, recruiting, developing, and retaining a diverse workforce, not only because it is the right thing to do, but because it helps us build a world\-class company to better serve our customers, our people and our communities.

 We manage the infrastructure efficiency for one of the world's largest data and AI platforms.  Are you passionate about building AI\-driven software that transforms how professionals work?
